2.1.3.s: rudro vā eṣaḥ | yadagniḥ | patnī sthālī | yanmadhye'gneradhiśrayet | rudrāya patnīmapi dadhyāt | pramāyukā syāt | udīco'ṅgārānnirūhyādhiśrayati | patniyai gopīthāya | vyantānkaroti | tathā patnyapramāyukā bhavati
2.1.3.d: रुद्रो वा एषः । यदग्निः । पत्नी स्थाली । यन्मध्येऽग्नेरधिश्रयेत् । रुद्राय पत्नीमपि दध्यात् । प्रमायुका स्यात् । उदीचोऽङ्गारान्निरूह्याधिश्रयति । पत्नियै गोपीथाय । व्यन्तान्करोति । तथा पत्न्यप्रमायुका भवति
2.1.3.m:
Rudra, indeed, is he
who is Agni.
The wife is the cooking pot.
If he should set it over the middle of the fire,
he would hand over the wife to Rudra;
she would be liable to perish.
Having pushed aside the embers to the north, he sets it over [the fire],
for the protection of the wife.
He keeps them separate;
thus the wife does not perish.

2.1.3.s: gharmo vā eṣo'śāntaḥ | aharahaḥ pravṛjyate | yadagnihotram | pratiṣiñcet paśukāmasya | śāntamiva hi paśavyam | na pratiṣiñced brahmavarcasakāmasya | samiddhamiva hi brahmavarcasam | atho khalu | pratiṣicyameva | yatpratiṣiñcati
2.1.3.d: घर्मो वा एषोऽशान्तः । अहरहः प्रवृज्यते । यदग्निहोत्रम् । प्रतिषिञ्चेत् पशुकामस्य । शान्तमिव हि पशव्यम् । न प्रतिषिञ्चेद् ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य । समिद्धमिव हि ब्रह्मवर्चसम् । अथो खलु । प्रतिषिच्यमेव । यत्प्रतिषिञ्चति
2.1.3.m:
A cauldron unappeased indeed is this,
which is heated day by day,
namely, the Agnihotra.
He should sprinkle water around for one who desires domestic animals,
for what is appeased belongs to domestic animals.
He should not sprinkle water around for one who desires spiritual preeminence,
for what is kindled belongs to spiritual preeminence.
Moreover, however,
it must indeed be sprinkled around.
In that he sprinkles around,

2.1.3.s: tatpaśavyam | yajjuhoti | tadbrahmavarcasi | ubhayamevākaḥ | pracyutaṃ vā etadasmāllokāt | agataṃ devalokam | yacchṛtaṃ haviranabhighāritam | abhidyotayati | abhyevainadghārayati | atho devatraivainadgamayati
2.1.3.d: तत्पशव्यम् । यज्जुहोति । तद्ब्रह्मवर्चसि । उभयमेवाकः । प्रच्युतं वा एतदस्माल्लोकात् । अगतं देवलोकम् । यच्छृतं हविरनभिघारितम् । अभिद्योतयति । अभ्येवैनद्घारयति । अथो देवत्रैवैनद्गमयति

2.1.3.s: paryagni karoti | rakṣasāmapahatyai | triḥ paryagni karoti | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ | atho medhyatvāya | yatprācīnamudvāsayet | yajamānaṃ śucā'rpayet | yaddakṣiṇā | pitṛdevatyaṃ syāt | yatpratyak
2.1.3.d: पर्यग्नि करोति । रक्षसामपहत्यै । त्रिः पर्यग्नि करोति । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः । अथो मेध्यत्वाय । यत्प्राचीनमुद्वासयेत् । यजमानं शुचाऽर्पयेत् । यद्दक्षिणा । पितृदेवत्यं स्यात् । यत्प्रत्यक्

2.1.3.s: patnīṃ śucā'rpayet | udīcīnamudvāsayati | eṣā vai devamanuṣyāṇāṃ śāntā dik | tāmevainadanūdvāsayati śāntyai | vartma karoti | yajñasya saṃtatyai | niṣṭapati | upaiva tathstṛṇāti | caturunnayati | catuṣpādaḥ paśavaḥ
2.1.3.d: पत्नीं शुचाऽर्पयेत् । उदीचीनमुद्वासयति । एषा वै देवमनुष्याणां शान्ता दिक् । तामेवैनदनूद्वासयति शान्त्यै । वर्त्म करोति । यज्ञस्य संतत्यै । निष्टपति । उपैव तथ्स्तृणाति । चतुरुन्नयति । चतुष्पादः पशवः

2.1.3.s: paśūnevāvarundhe | sarvānpūrṇānunnayati | sarve hi puṇyā rāddhāḥ | anūca unnayati | prajāyā anūcīnatvāya | anūcyevāsya prajā'rdhukā bhavati || saṃmṛśati vyāvṛttyai | nāhoṣyannupasādayet | yadahoṣyannupasādayet | yathā'nyasmā upanidhāya
2.1.3.d: पशूनेवावरुन्धे । सर्वान्पूर्णानुन्नयति । सर्वे हि पुण्या राद्धाः । अनूच उन्नयति । प्रजाया अनूचीनत्वाय । अनूच्येवास्य प्रजाऽर्धुका भवति ॥ संमृशति व्यावृत्त्यै । नाहोष्यन्नुपसादयेत् । यदहोष्यन्नुपसादयेत् । यथाऽन्यस्मा उपनिधाय
2.1.3.m:
he secures domestic animals.
He ladles out all of them full,
for all auspicious things are achieved.
He ladles them out one after another,
so that offspring may be born one after another;
offspring succeed one after another for him.
He wipes [the ladle] for distinction.
He should not set it down if he does not intend to offer.
If he should set it down when not intending to offer,
just as having placed [food] before one person,

2.1.3.s: anyasmai prayacchati | tādṛgeva tat | ā'smai vṛścyeta | yadeva gārhapatye'dhiśrayati | tena gārhapatyaṃ prīṇāti | agnirabibhet | āhutayo mā'tyeṣyantīti | sa etāṃ samidhamapaśyat | tāmā'dhatta | tato vā agnāvāhutayo'dhriyanta
2.1.3.d: अन्यस्मै प्रयच्छति । तादृगेव तत् । आऽस्मै वृश्च्येत । यदेव गार्हपत्येऽधिश्रयति । तेन गार्हपत्यं प्रीणाति । अग्निरबिभेत् । आहुतयो माऽत्येष्यन्तीति । स एतां समिधमपश्यत् । तामाऽधत्त । ततो वा अग्नावाहुतयोऽध्रियन्त

2.1.3.s: yadenaṃ samayacchat | tathsamidhaḥ samittvam | samidhamādadhāti | samevainaṃ yacchati | āhutīnāṃ dhṛtyai | atho agnihotramevedhmavatkaroti | āhutīnāṃ pratiṣṭhityai | brahmavādino vadanti | yadekāṃ samidhamādhāya dve āhutī juhoti | atha kasyāṃ samidhi dvitīyāmāhutiṃ juhotīti
2.1.3.d: यदेनं समयच्छत् । तथ्समिधः समित्त्वम् । समिधमादधाति । समेवैनं यच्छति । आहुतीनां धृत्यै । अथो अग्निहोत्रमेवेध्मवत्करोति । आहुतीनां प्रतिष्ठित्यै । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । यदेकां समिधमाधाय द्वे आहुती जुहोति । अथ कस्यां समिधि द्वितीयामाहुतिं जुहोतीति
2.1.3.m:
In that it held him together,
that is the kindling-ness of the kindling stick.
He places the kindling stick upon [the fire];
he holds him together,
for the retention of the oblations;
and also he makes the Agnihotra provided with firewood,
for the firm establishment of the oblations.
The discussers of sacred lore say:
'Since having placed one kindling stick he offers two oblations,
then upon which kindling stick does he offer the second oblation?'

2.1.3.s: yaddve samidhāvādadhyāt | bhrātṛvyamasmai janayet | ekāṃ samidhamādhāya | yajuṣā'nyāmāhutiṃ juhoti | ubhe eva samidvatī āhutī juhoti | nāsmai bhrātṛvyaṃ janayati | ādīptāyāṃ juhoti | samiddhamiva hi brahmavarcasam | atho yathā'tithiṃ jyotiṣkṛtvā pariveveṣṭi | tādṛgeva tat | caturunnayati | dvirjuhoti | tasmāddvipāccatuṣpādamatti | atho dvipadyeva catuṣpadaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati
2.1.3.d: यद्द्वे समिधावादध्यात् । भ्रातृव्यमस्मै जनयेत् । एकां समिधमाधाय । यजुषाऽन्यामाहुतिं जुहोति । उभे एव समिद्वती आहुती जुहोति । नास्मै भ्रातृव्यं जनयति । आदीप्तायां जुहोति । समिद्धमिव हि ब्रह्मवर्चसम् । अथो यथाऽतिथिं ज्योतिष्कृत्वा परिवेवेष्टि । तादृगेव तत् । चतुरुन्नयति । द्विर्जुहोति । तस्माद्द्विपाच्चतुष्पादमत्ति । अथो द्विपद्येव चतुष्पदः प्रतिष्ठापयति
2.1.3.m: If he were to lay on two kindling-sticks, he would generate a rival for him. Having laid on one kindling-stick, he offers the other oblation with a sacrificial formula; he offers both oblations as possessed of kindling-sticks; he does not generate a rival for him. He offers when it is blazing, for spiritual preeminence is, as it were, kindled. And just as one attends upon a guest having made a light, such indeed is that. Four times he ladles out. Twice he offers. Therefore the two-footed eats the four-footed. And he establishes four-footed [beasts] in the two-footed.

2.1.4.s: uttarāvatīṃ vai devā āhutimajuhavuḥ | avācīmasurāḥ | tato devā abhavan | parā'surāḥ | yaṃ kāmayeta vasīyānthsyāditi | kanīyastasya pūrvaṃ hutvā | uttaraṃ bhūyo juhuyāt | eṣā vā uttarāvatyāhutiḥ | tāṃ devā ajuhavuḥ | tataste'bhavan
2.1.4.d: उत्तरावतीं वै देवा आहुतिमजुहवुः । अवाचीमसुराः । ततो देवा अभवन् । पराऽसुराः । यं कामयेत वसीयान्थ्स्यादिति । कनीयस्तस्य पूर्वं हुत्वा । उत्तरं भूयो जुहुयात् । एषा वा उत्तरावत्याहुतिः । तां देवा अजुहवुः । ततस्तेऽभवन्
2.1.4.m: The gods offered an ascending oblation; the asuras, a descending [oblation]. Then the gods prospered; the asuras perished. For whomever he desires, 'May he become wealthier,' having offered less for his earlier [oblation], he should offer more for the later. This indeed is the ascending oblation; the gods offered it; then they prospered.

2.1.4.s: yasyaivaṃ juhvati | bhavatyeva | yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyānthsyāditi | bhūyastasya pūrvaṃ hutvā | uttaraṃ kanīyo juhuyāt | eṣā vā avācyāhutiḥ | tāmasurā ajuhavuḥ | tataste parā'bhavan | yasyaivaṃ juhvati | paraiva bhavati
2.1.4.d: यस्यैवं जुह्वति । भवत्येव । यं कामयेत पापीयान्थ्स्यादिति । भूयस्तस्य पूर्वं हुत्वा । उत्तरं कनीयो जुहुयात् । एषा वा अवाच्याहुतिः । तामसुरा अजुहवुः । ततस्ते पराऽभवन् । यस्यैवं जुह्वति । परैव भवति
2.1.4.m: For whomever they offer in this way, he indeed prospers. For whomever he desires, 'May he become worse off,' having offered more for his earlier [oblation], he should offer less for the later. This indeed is the descending oblation; the asuras offered it; then they perished. For whomever they offer in this way, he indeed perishes.

2.1.4.s: hutvopasādayatyajāmitvāya | atho vyāvṛttyai | gārhapatyaṃ pratīkṣate | ananudhyāyinamevainaṃ karoti | agnihotrasya vai sthāṇurasti | taṃ ya ṛcchet | yajñasthāṇumṛcchet | eṣa vā agnihotrasya sthāṇuḥ | yatpūrvā''hutiḥ | tāṃ yaduttarayā'bhijuhuyāt
2.1.4.d: हुत्वोपसादयत्यजामित्वाय । अथो व्यावृत्त्यै । गार्हपत्यं प्रतीक्षते । अननुध्यायिनमेवैनं करोति । अग्निहोत्रस्य वै स्थाणुरस्ति । तं य ऋच्छेत् । यज्ञस्थाणुमृच्छेत् । एष वा अग्निहोत्रस्य स्थाणुः । यत्पूर्वा'ऽहुतिः । तां यदुत्तरयाऽभिजुहुयात्
2.1.4.m:
Having offered, he sets [the ladle] down, for non-fatigue, and also for separation. He looks toward the Gārhapatya; he makes him not look back with regret. There is indeed a stump of the Agnihotra. If he should run into it, he would run into the stump of the sacrifice. This indeed is the stump of the Agnihotra: that which is the earlier oblation. If he should offer over it with the later oblation,

he would run into the stump of the sacrifice. Passing over the earlier oblation, he offers; he avoids the stump of the sacrifice. And having overtaken his rival, he steps beyond him. He wipes downward in the evening; he thus deposits semen. Upward in the morning; he thus brings forth. Discussers of sacred lore say: 'Four times he ladles out;

2.1.4.s: yajñasthāṇumṛcchet | atihāya pūrvāmāhutiṃ juhoti | yajñasthāṇumeva parivṛṇakti | atho bhrātṛvyamevāptvā'tikrāmati | avācīnaṃ sāyamupamārṣṭi | reta eva taddadhāti | ūrdhvaṃ prātaḥ | prajanayatyeva tat | brahmavādino vadanti | caturunnayati
2.1.4.d: यज्ञस्थाणुमृच्छेत् । अतिहाय पूर्वामाहुतिं जुहोति । यज्ञस्थाणुमेव परिवृणक्ति । अथो भ्रातृव्यमेवाप्त्वाऽतिक्रामति । अवाचीनं सायमुपमार्ष्टि । रेत एव तद्दधाति । ऊर्ध्वं प्रातः । प्रजनयत्येव तत् । ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । चतुरुन्नयति

2.1.4.s: dvirjuhoti | atha kva dve āhutī bhavata iti | agnau vaiśvānara iti brūyāt | eṣa vā agnirvaiśvānaraḥ | yadbrāhmaṇaḥ | hutvā dviḥ prāśnāti | agnāveva vaiśvānare dve āhutī juhoti | dvirjuhoti | dvirnimārṣṭi | dviḥ prāśnāti
2.1.4.d: द्विर्जुहोति । अथ क्व द्वे आहुती भवत इति । अग्नौ वैश्वानर इति ब्रूयात् । एष वा अग्निर्वैश्वानरः । यद्ब्राह्मणः । हुत्वा द्विः प्राश्नाति । अग्नावेव वैश्वानरे द्वे आहुती जुहोति । द्विर्जुहोति । द्विर्निमार्ष्टि । द्विः प्राश्नाति
2.1.4.m: twice he offers. Then where are the two oblations [completed]?' He should say, 'In the fire Vaiśvānara.' This indeed is the fire Vaiśvānara, namely, the Brahmin. Having offered, he consumes twice; he offers the two oblations in the fire Vaiśvānara itself. Twice he offers; twice he wipes; twice he consumes.

2.1.4.s: ṣaṭthsaṃpadyante | ṣaḍvā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūneva prīṇāti || brahmavādino vadanti | kiṃdevatyamagnihotramiti | vaiśvadevamiti brūyāt | yadyajuṣā juhoti | tadaindrāgnam | yattūṣṇīm | tatprājāpatyam
2.1.4.d: षट्थ्संपद्यन्ते । षड्वा ऋतवः । ऋतूनेव प्रीणाति ॥ ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । किंदेवत्यमग्निहोत्रमिति । वैश्वदेवमिति ब्रूयात् । यद्यजुषा जुहोति । तदैन्द्राग्नम् । यत्तूष्णीम् । तत्प्राजापत्यम्
2.1.4.m: They amount to six. Six indeed are the seasons; he gratifies the seasons themselves. Discussers of sacred lore say: 'Which deity belongs to the Agnihotra?' He should say, 'Belonging to the All-gods.' That which he offers with a sacrificial formula, that belongs to Indra and Agni. That which [he offers] silently, that belongs to Prajāpati.

2.1.4.s: yannimārṣṭi | tadoṣadhīnām | yaddvitīyam | tatpitṛṇām | yatprāśnāti | tadgarbhāṇām | tasmādgarbhā anaśnanto vardhante | yadācāmati | tanmanuṣyāṇām | udaṅparyāvṛtyācāmati
2.1.4.d: यन्निमार्ष्टि । तदोषधीनाम् । यद्द्वितीयम् । तत्पितृणाम् । यत्प्राश्नाति । तद्गर्भाणाम् । तस्माद्गर्भा अनश्नन्तो वर्धन्ते । यदाचामति । तन्मनुष्याणाम् । उदङ्पर्यावृत्याचामति
2.1.4.m: That which he wipes [first], that belongs to the plants. That which [he wipes] the second time, that belongs to the fathers. That which he consumes, that belongs to the embryos; therefore embryos grow without eating. That which he sips water, that belongs to human beings. Having turned toward the north, he sips water,

2.1.4.s: ātmano gopīthāya | nirṇenekti śuddhyai | niṣṭapati svagākṛtyai | uddiśati | saptarṣīneva prīṇāti | dakṣiṇā paryāvartate | svameva vīryamanuparyāvartate | tasmāddakṣiṇo'rdha ātmano vīryāvattaraḥ | atho ādityasyaivāvṛtamanuparyāvartate | hutvopasamindhe
2.1.4.d: आत्मनो गोपीथाय । निर्णेनेक्ति शुद्ध्यै । निष्टपति स्वगाकृत्यै । उद्दिशति । सप्तर्षीनेव प्रीणाति । दक्षिणा पर्यावर्तते । स्वमेव वीर्यमनुपर्यावर्तते । तस्माद्दक्षिणोऽर्ध आत्मनो वीर्यावत्तरः । अथो आदित्यस्यैवावृतमनुपर्यावर्तते । हुत्वोपसमिन्धे
2.1.4.m: for the protection of himself. He rinses for purity. He heats [the ladle] over the fire for making it acceptable. He points it out; he gratifies the Seven Seers themselves. He turns around toward the south; he turns along with his own heroic power. Therefore the right side of oneself is more endowed with heroic power. Moreover, he turns along with the course of the sun. Having offered, he kindles up [the fire],

2.1.4.s: brahmavarcasasya samiddhyai | na barhiranupraharet | asaṃsthito vā eṣa yajñaḥ | yadagnihotram | yadanupraharet | yajñaṃ vicchindyāt | tasmānnānuprahṛtyam | yajñasya saṃtatyai | apo ninayati | avabhṛthasyaiva rūpamakaḥ
2.1.4.d: ब्रह्मवर्चसस्य समिद्ध्यै । न बर्हिरनुप्रहरेत् । असंस्थितो वा एष यज्ञः । यदग्निहोत्रम् । यदनुप्रहरेत् । यज्ञं विच्छिन्द्यात् । तस्मान्नानुप्रहृत्यम् । यज्ञस्य संतत्यै । अपो निनयति । अवभृथस्यैव रूपमकः
2.1.4.m: for the kindling of spiritual preeminence. He should not throw the strewn grass after [into the fire]; for this sacrifice is uncompleted, namely, the Agnihotra. If he were to throw it after, he would cut off the sacrifice. Therefore it is not to be thrown after, for the continuity of the sacrifice. He pours out water; he has made the form of the final purification bath itself.

2.1.5.s: brahmavādino vadanti | agnihotraprāyaṇā yajñāḥ | kiṃ prāyaṇamagnihotramiti | vathso vā agnihotrasya prāyaṇam | agnihotraṃ yajñānām | tasya pṛthivī sadaḥ | antarikṣamāgnīddhram | dyaurhavirdhānam | divyā āpaḥ prokṣaṇayaḥ | oṣadhayo barhiḥ
2.1.5.d: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति । अग्निहोत्रप्रायणा यज्ञाः । किं प्रायणमग्निहोत्रमिति । वथ्सो वा अग्निहोत्रस्य प्रायणम् । अग्निहोत्रं यज्ञानाम् । तस्य पृथिवी सदः । अन्तरिक्षमाग्नीद्ध्रम् । द्यौर्हविर्धानम् । दिव्या आपः प्रोक्षणयः । ओषधयो बर्हिः
2.1.5.m: Discussers of sacred lore say: 'The sacrifices have the Agnihotra as their entry. What has the Agnihotra as its entry?' The calf indeed is the entry of the Agnihotra; the Agnihotra [is the entry] of the sacrifices. Its seating-shed is the earth; the Āgnīdhra shed is the intermediate space; the cart-shed is the sky; the sprinkling waters are divine waters; the strewn grass is the plants;

2.1.5.s: vanaspataya idhmaḥ | diśaḥ paridhayaḥ | ādityo yūpaḥ | yajamānaḥ paśuḥ | samudro'vabhṛthaḥ | saṃvathsaraḥ svagākāraḥ | tasmādāhitāgneḥ sarvameva barhiṣyaṃ dattaṃ bhavati | yathsāyaṃ juhoti | rātrimeva tena dakṣiṇyāṃ kurute | yatprātaḥ
2.1.5.d: वनस्पतय इध्मः । दिशः परिधयः । आदित्यो यूपः । यजमानः पशुः । समुद्रोऽवभृथः । संवथ्सरः स्वगाकारः । तस्मादाहिताग्नेः सर्वमेव बर्हिष्यं दत्तं भवति । यथ्सायं जुहोति । रात्रिमेव तेन दक्षिण्यां कुरुते । यत्प्रातः
2.1.5.m: the kindling-wood is the trees; the enclosing sticks are the directions; the sacrificial post is the sun; the domestic animal is the sacrificer; the final purification bath is the ocean; the year is the exclamation of 'svagā'. Therefore for the one who has established the fires, everything is given on the strewn grass. When he offers in the evening, with that he makes the night worthy of a sacrificial fee. When in the morning,

2.1.5.s: ahareva tena dakṣiṇyaṃ kurute | yattato dadāti | sā dakṣiṇā | yāvanto vai devā ahutamādan | te parā'bhavan | ta etadagnihotraṃ sarvasyaiva samavadāyājuhavuḥ | tasmādāhuḥ | agnihotraṃ vai devā gṛhāṇāṃ niṣkṛtimapaśyanniti | yathsāyaṃ juhoti | rātriyā eva taddhutādyāya
2.1.5.d: अहरेव तेन दक्षिण्यं कुरुते । यत्ततो ददाति । सा दक्षिणा । यावन्तो वै देवा अहुतमादन् । ते पराऽभवन् । त एतदग्निहोत्रं सर्वस्यैव समवदायाजुहवुः । तस्मादाहुः । अग्निहोत्रं वै देवा गृहाणां निष्कृतिमपश्यन्निति । यथ्सायं जुहोति । रात्रिया एव तद्धुताद्याय
2.1.5.m: with that he makes the day worthy of a sacrificial fee. That which he gives from it, that is the sacrificial fee. As many of the gods as ate what was unoffered, they perished. They offered this Agnihotra having sliced portions from everything. Therefore they say: 'The two saw the Agnihotra as the expiation of the household.' When he offers in the evening, that is for the night's eating of what is offered,

2.1.5.s: yajamānasyāparābhāvāya | yatprātaḥ | ahna eva taddhutādyāya | yajamānasyāparābhāvāya | yattato'śnāti | hutameva tat | dvayoḥ payasā juhuyātpaśukāmasya | etadvā agnihotraṃ mithunam | ya evaṃ veda | pra prajayā paśubhirmithunairjāyate
2.1.5.d: यजमानस्यापराभावाय । यत्प्रातः । अह्न एव तद्धुताद्याय । यजमानस्यापराभावाय । यत्ततोऽश्नाति । हुतमेव तत् । द्वयोः पयसा जुहुयात्पशुकामस्य । एतद्वा अग्निहोत्रं मिथुनम् । य एवं वेद । प्र प्रजया पशुभिर्मिथुनैर्जायते
2.1.5.m: for the non-perishing of the sacrificer. When in the morning, that is for the day's eating of what is offered, for the non-perishing of the sacrificer. That which he eats from it, that is indeed offered. He should offer with the milk of two [cows] for one who desires domestic animals; for this Agnihotra is a pair. He who knows thus is propagated with offspring and domestic animals in pairs.

2.1.5.s: imāmeva pūrvayā duhe | amūmuttarayā | adhiśrityottaramānayati | yonāveva tadretaḥ siñcati prajanane | ājyena juhuyāttejaskāmasya | tejo vā ājyam | tejasvyeva bhavati | payasā paśukāmasya | etadvai paśūnāṃ rūpam | rūpeṇaivāsmai paśūnavarundhe
2.1.5.d: इमामेव पूर्वया दुहे । अमूमुत्तरया । अधिश्रित्योत्तरमानयति । योनावेव तद्रेतः सिञ्चति प्रजनने । आज्येन जुहुयात्तेजस्कामस्य । तेजो वा आज्यम् । तेजस्व्येव भवति । पयसा पशुकामस्य । एतद्वै पशूनां रूपम् । रूपेणैवास्मै पशूनवरुन्धे
2.1.5.m: He milks this [cow] with the first [act]; that [cow] with the second. Having placed it on [the fire], he brings the latter [milk]; he thus pours semen into the womb for generation. He should offer with ghee for one who desires fiery energy; ghee indeed is fiery energy; he becomes endowed with fiery energy. With milk for one who desires domestic animals; this indeed is the form of domestic animals; by its form he secures domestic animals for him.

2.1.5.s: paśumāneva bhavati | dadhnendriyakāmasya | indriyaṃ vai dadhi | indriyāvyeva bhavati | yavāgvā grāmakāmasyauṣadhā vai manuṣyāḥ | bhāgadheyenaivāsmai sajātānavarundhe | grāmyeva bhavati | ayajño vā eṣaḥ | yo'sāmā
2.1.5.d: पशुमानेव भवति । दध्नेन्द्रियकामस्य । इन्द्रियं वै दधि । इन्द्रियाव्येव भवति । यवाग्वा ग्रामकामस्यौषधा वै मनुष्याः । भागधेयेनैवास्मै सजातानवरुन्धे । ग्राम्येव भवति । अयज्ञो वा एषः । योऽसामा
2.1.5.m: He becomes possessed of domestic animals. With curd for one who desires vital power; curd indeed is vital power; he becomes endowed with vital power. With barley gruel for one who desires a community; human beings are indeed [dependent on] plants; through his share he secures his kinsmen for him; he becomes possessed of a community. Non-sacrifice indeed is that which is without sāman.

2.1.5.s: caturunnayati | caturakṣaraṃ rathantaram | rathantarasyaiṣa varṇaḥ | uparīva harati | antarikṣaṃ vāmadevyam | vāmadevyasyaiṣa varṇaḥ | dvirjuhoti | dvyakṣaraṃ bṛhat | bṛhata eṣa varṇaḥ | agnihotrameva tathsāmanvatkaroti
2.1.5.d: चतुरुन्नयति । चतुरक्षरं रथन्तरम् । रथन्तरस्यैष वर्णः । उपरीव हरति । अन्तरिक्षं वामदेव्यम् । वामदेव्यस्यैष वर्णः । द्विर्जुहोति । द्व्यक्षरं बृहत् । बृहत एष वर्णः । अग्निहोत्रमेव तथ्सामन्वत्करोति
2.1.5.m: Four times he ladles out; four-syllabled is the Rathaṃtara; this is the color of the Rathaṃtara. He carries it upwards, as it were; the intermediate space is the Vāmadevya; this is the color of the Vāmadevya. Twice he offers; two-syllabled is the Bṛhat; this is the color of the Bṛhat. He thus makes the Agnihotra possessed of sāmans.

2.1.5.s: yo vā agnihotrasyopasado veda | upainamupasado namanti | vindata upasattāram | unnīyopasādayati | pṛthivīmeva prīṇāti | hoṣyannupasādayati | antarikṣameva prīṇāti | hutvopasādayati | divameva prīṇāti | etā vā agnihotrasyopasadaḥ
2.1.5.d: यो वा अग्निहोत्रस्योपसदो वेद । उपैनमुपसदो नमन्ति । विन्दत उपसत्तारम् । उन्नीयोपसादयति । पृथिवीमेव प्रीणाति । होष्यन्नुपसादयति । अन्तरिक्षमेव प्रीणाति । हुत्वोपसादयति । दिवमेव प्रीणाति । एता वा अग्निहोत्रस्योपसदः
2.1.5.m: He who knows the upasads of the Agnihotra, / to him the upasads bow; / he finds one who serves [him]. / Having ladled out, he sets it down: / he pleases the earth. / Intending to offer, he sets it down: / he pleases the intermediate space. / Having offered, he sets it down: / he pleases heaven. / These indeed are the upasads of the Agnihotra.

2.1.5.s: ya evaṃ veda | upainamupasado namanti | vindata upasattāram | yo vā agnihotrasyāśrāvitaṃ pratyāśrāvitaṃ hotāraṃ brahmāṇaṃ vaṣaṭkāraṃ veda | tasya tveva hutam | prāṇo vā agnihotrasyāśrāvitam | apānaḥ pratyāśrāvitam | mano hotā | cakṣurbrahmā | nimeṣo vaṣaṭkāraḥ
2.1.5.d: य एवं वेद । उपैनमुपसदो नमन्ति । विन्दत उपसत्तारम् । यो वा अग्निहोत्रस्याश्रावितं प्रत्याश्रावितं होतारं ब्रह्माणं वषट्कारं वेद । तस्य त्वेव हुतम् । प्राणो वा अग्निहोत्रस्याश्रावितम् । अपानः प्रत्याश्रावितम् । मनो होता । चक्षुर्ब्रह्मा । निमेषो वषट्कारः
2.1.5.m: He who knows thus, / to him the upasads bow; / he finds one who serves [him]. / He who knows the call, the response, the hotṛ, the brahman priest, and the vaṣaṭ-call of the Agnihotra, / of him indeed the offering is made. / The call of the Agnihotra is the exhalation, / the response is the inhalation, / the hotṛ is the mind, / the brahman priest is the eye, / the vaṣaṭ-call is the blinking of the eye.

2.1.5.s: ya evaṃ veda | tasya tveva hutam | sāyaṃyāvānaśca vai devāḥ prātaryāvāṇaścāgnihotriṇo gṛhamāgacchanti | tān yanna tarpayet | prajayā'sya paśubhirvitiṣṭheran | yattarpayet | tṛptā enaṃ prajayā paśubhistarpayeyuḥ | sajūrdevaiḥ sāyaṃ yāvabhiriti sāyaṃ saṃmṛśati | sajūrdevaiḥ prātaryāvabhiriti prātaḥ | ye caiva devāḥ sāyaṃ yāvāno ye ca prātaryāvāṇaḥ
2.1.5.d: य एवं वेद । तस्य त्वेव हुतम् । सायंयावानश्च वै देवाः प्रातर्यावाणश्चाग्निहोत्रिणो गृहमागच्छन्ति । तान् यन्न तर्पयेत् । प्रजयाऽस्य पशुभिर्वितिष्ठेरन् । यत्तर्पयेत् । तृप्ता एनं प्रजया पशुभिस्तर्पयेयुः । सजूर्देवैः सायं यावभिरिति सायं संमृशति । सजूर्देवैः प्रातर्यावभिरिति प्रातः । ये चैव देवाः सायं यावानो ये च प्रातर्यावाणः
2.1.5.m: He who knows thus, / of him indeed the offering is made. / The gods who go in the evening and the gods who go in the morning come to the home of the Agnihotra-offerer. / If he were not to gratify them, / they would depart with his offspring and domestic animals. / When he gratifies [them], / gratified, they gratify him with offspring and domestic animals. / 'United with the gods who go in the evening', thus he touches [it] in the evening; / 'United with the gods who go in the morning', thus in the morning. / Both the gods who go in the evening and those who go in the morning—

2.1.5.s: tānevobhayāṃstarpayati | ta enaṃ tṛptāḥ prajayā paśubhistarpayanti | aruṇo ha smāhaupaveśiḥ | agnihotra evāhaṃ sāyaṃ prātarvajraṃ bhrātṛvyebhyaḥ praharāmi | tasmānmatpāpīyāṃso bhrātṛvyā iti | caturunnayati | dvirjuhoti | samithsaptamī | saptapadā śakvarī | śākvaro vajraḥ | agnihotra eva tathsāyaṃ prātarvajraṃ yajamāno bhrātṛvyāya praharati | bhavatyātmanā | parā'sya bhrātṛvyo bhavati
2.1.5.d: तानेवोभयांस्तर्पयति । त एनं तृप्ताः प्रजया पशुभिस्तर्पयन्ति । अरुणो ह स्माहौपवेशिः । अग्निहोत्र एवाहं सायं प्रातर्वज्रं भ्रातृव्येभ्यः प्रहरामि । तस्मान्मत्पापीयांसो भ्रातृव्या इति । चतुरुन्नयति । द्विर्जुहोति । समिथ्सप्तमी । सप्तपदा शक्वरी । शाक्वरो वज्रः । अग्निहोत्र एव तथ्सायं प्रातर्वज्रं यजमानो भ्रातृव्याय प्रहरति । भवत्यात्मना । पराऽस्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति
2.1.5.m: both of them he gratifies. / Gratified, they gratify him with offspring and domestic animals. / Aruṇa Aupaveśi used to say: / 'In the Agnihotra, evening and morning, I hurl the thunderbolt against my rivals; / therefore my rivals are worse off than I.' / Four times he ladles out; / twice he offers; / the kindling stick is the seventh. / The śakvarī [meter] has seven feet; / the thunderbolt belongs to the śakvarī. / In the Agnihotra, evening and morning, the sacrificer hurls the thunderbolt against his rival. / He prospers in himself; / his rival is defeated.

2.1.6.s: prajāpatirakāmayatātmanvanme jāyeteti | so'juhot | tasyātmanvadajāyata | agnirvāyurādityaḥ | te'bruvan | prajāpatirahauṣīdātmanvanme jāyeteti | tasya vayamajaniṣmahi | jāyatāṃ na ātmanvaditi te'juhavuḥ | prāṇānāmagniḥ | tanuvai vāyuḥ
2.1.6.d: प्रजापतिरकामयतात्मन्वन्मे जायेतेति । सोऽजुहोत् । तस्यात्मन्वदजायत । अग्निर्वायुरादित्यः । तेऽब्रुवन् । प्रजापतिरहौषीदात्मन्वन्मे जायेतेति । तस्य वयमजनिष्महि । जायतां न आत्मन्वदिति तेऽजुहवुः । प्राणानामग्निः । तनुवै वायुः
2.1.6.m: Prajāpati desired: 'May that which is endowed with breath be born to me.' / He offered. / To him that which was endowed with breath was born: / Agni, Vāyu, and Āditya. / They said: / 'Prajāpati offered, [saying] “May that which is endowed with breath be born to me.” / From him we were born. / Let that which is endowed with breath be born to us.' Thus they offered: / Agni for the exhalations, / Vāyu for the body,

2.1.6.s: cakṣuṣa ādityaḥ | teṣāṃ hutādajāyata gaureva | tasyai payasi vyāyacchanta | mama hutādajani mameti | te prajāpatiṃ praśnamāyan | sa ādityo'gnimabravīt | yataro nau jayāt | tannau sahāsaditi | kasyaiko'hauṣīditi prajāpatirabravītkasyai ka iti | prāṇānāmahamityagniḥ
2.1.6.d: चक्षुष आदित्यः । तेषां हुतादजायत गौरेव । तस्यै पयसि व्यायच्छन्त । मम हुतादजनि ममेति । ते प्रजापतिं प्रश्नमायन् । स आदित्योऽग्निमब्रवीत् । यतरो नौ जयात् । तन्नौ सहासदिति । कस्यैकोऽहौषीदिति प्रजापतिरब्रवीत्कस्यै क इति । प्राणानामहमित्यग्निः
2.1.6.m: Āditya for the eye. / From what they offered the cow was born. / Over her milk they disputed: / 'It was born from what I offered!' 'From mine!' / They went to Prajāpati for a decision. / Āditya said to Agni: / 'Whichever of us two shall win, / let it belong to both of us together.' / 'For what did the one offer?' Prajāpati said, 'For what the one?' / 'I for the exhalations,' said Agni,

2.1.6.s: tanuvā ahamiti vāyuḥ | cakṣuṣo'hamityādityaḥ | ya eva prāṇānāmahauṣīt | tasya hutādajanīti | agnerhutādajanīti | tadagnihotrasyāgnihotratvam | gaurvā agnihotram | ya evaṃ veda gauragnihotramiti | prāṇāpānābhyāmevāgniṃ samardhayati | avyardhukaḥ prāṇāpānābhyāṃ bhavati
2.1.6.d: तनुवा अहमिति वायुः । चक्षुषोऽहमित्यादित्यः । य एव प्राणानामहौषीत् । तस्य हुतादजनीति । अग्नेर्हुतादजनीति । तदग्निहोत्रस्याग्निहोत्रत्वम् । गौर्वा अग्निहोत्रम् । य एवं वेद गौरग्निहोत्रमिति । प्राणापानाभ्यामेवाग्निं समर्धयति । अव्यर्धुकः प्राणापानाभ्यां भवति
2.1.6.m: 'I for the body,' said Vāyu, / 'I for the eye,' said Āditya. / 'He who offered for the exhalations, / from his offering it was born, / from Agni's offering it was born.' / That is why the Agnihotra is called Agnihotra. / The cow is indeed the Agnihotra. / He who knows thus that the cow is the Agnihotra / enriches Agni with exhalation and inhalation; / he does not become deprived of exhalation and inhalation,

2.1.6.s: ya evaṃ veda | tau vāyurabravīt | anu mā bhajatamiti | yadeva gārhapatye'dhiśrityāhavanīyamabhyuddravān | tena tvāṃ prīṇānityabrūtām | tasmādyadgārhapatye'dhiśrityāhavanīyamabhyuddravati | vāyumeva tena prīṇāti | prajāpatirdevatāḥ sṛjamānaḥ | agnimeva devatānāṃ prathamamasṛjata | so'nyadālambhyamavittvā
2.1.6.d: य एवं वेद । तौ वायुरब्रवीत् । अनु मा भजतमिति । यदेव गार्हपत्येऽधिश्रित्याहवनीयमभ्युद्द्रवान् । तेन त्वां प्रीणानित्यब्रूताम् । तस्माद्यद्गार्हपत्येऽधिश्रित्याहवनीयमभ्युद्द्रवति । वायुमेव तेन प्रीणाति । प्रजापतिर्देवताः सृजमानः । अग्निमेव देवतानां प्रथममसृजत । सोऽन्यदालम्भ्यमवित्त्वा
2.1.6.m: who knows thus. / To the two Vāyu said: / 'Assign me a share!' / 'When, having placed [the milk] on the gārhapatya [fire], they run toward the āhavanīya, / by that let them please you,' the two said. / Therefore, when having placed [it] on the gārhapatya, one runs toward the āhavanīya, / he pleases Vāyu by that. / Prajāpati, creating the deities, / created Agni first among the deities. / He, finding no other victim,

2.1.6.s: prajāpatimabhiparyāvartata | sa mṛtyorabibhet | so'mumādityamātmano niramimīta | taṃ hutvā parāṅ paryāvartata | tato vai sa mṛtyumapājayat | apamṛtyuṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda | tasmādyasyaivaṃ viduṣaḥ | utaikāhamuta dvyahaṃ na juhvati | hutamevāsya bhavati | asau hyādityo'gnihotram
2.1.6.d: प्रजापतिमभिपर्यावर्तत । स मृत्योरबिभेत् । सोऽमुमादित्यमात्मनो निरमिमीत । तं हुत्वा पराङ् पर्यावर्तत । ततो वै स मृत्युमपाजयत् । अपमृत्युं जयति । य एवं वेद । तस्माद्यस्यैवं विदुषः । उतैकाहमुत द्व्यहं न जुह्वति । हुतमेवास्य भवति । असौ ह्यादित्योऽग्निहोत्रम्
2.1.6.m: turned back toward Prajāpati. / He feared death. / He created that sun from himself. / Having offered it, he turned away. / Thence indeed he conquered death. / He conquers death / who knows thus. / Therefore, for one who knows thus, / even if they do not offer for one day or two days, / it is indeed offered for him, / for yonder sun is the Agnihotra.

2.1.7.s: raudraṃ gavi | vāyavyamupasṛṣṭam | āśvinaṃ duhyamānam | saumyaṃ dugdham | vāruṇamadhiśritam | vaiśvadevā bhindavaḥ | pauṣṇamudantam | sārasvataṃ viṣyandamānam | maitraṃ śaraḥ | dhāturudvāsitam | bṛhaspaterunnītam | savituḥ prakrāntam | dyāvāpṛthivyagg hriyamāṇam | aindrāgnamupasannam | agneḥ pūrvā''hutiḥ | prajāpateruttarā | aindraṃ hutam
2.1.7.d: रौद्रं गवि । वायव्यमुपसृष्टम् । आश्विनं दुह्यमानम् । सौम्यं दुग्धम् । वारुणमधिश्रितम् । वैश्वदेवा भिन्दवः । पौष्णमुदन्तम् । सारस्वतं विष्यन्दमानम् । मैत्रं शरः । धातुरुद्वासितम् । बृहस्पतेरुन्नीतम् । सवितुः प्रक्रान्तम् । द्यावापृथिव्यग्ग् ह्रियमाणम् । ऐन्द्राग्नमुपसन्नम् । अग्नेः पूर्वा'ऽहुतिः । प्रजापतेरुत्तरा । ऐन्द्रं हुतम्
2.1.7.m: Belonging to Rudra in the cow; / belonging to Vāyu when let loose [to the calf]; / belonging to the Aśvins when being milked; / belonging to Soma when milked; / belonging to Varuṇa when placed on the fire; / belonging to the Viśvedevas are the drops; / belonging to Pūṣan when boiling up; / belonging to Sarasvatī when overflowing; / belonging to Mitra the scum; / belonging to Dhātṛ when removed [from the fire]; / belonging to Bṛhaspati when ladled out; / belonging to Savitṛ when stepped forward; / belonging to heaven and earth when being carried; / belonging to Indra and Agni when set down; / belonging to Agni the first oblation; / belonging to Prajāpati the second; / belonging to Indra when offered.

2.1.8.s: dakṣiṇata upasṛjati | pitṛlokameva tena jayati | prācīmāvartayati | devalokameva tena jayati | udīcīmāvṛtya dogdhi | manuṣyalokameva tena jayati | pūrvau duhyājjyeṣṭhasya jyaiṣṭhineyasya | yo vā gataśrīḥ syāt | aparau duhyātkaniṣṭhasya kāniṣṭhineyasya | yo vā bubhūṣet
2.1.8.d: दक्षिणत उपसृजति । पितृलोकमेव तेन जयति । प्राचीमावर्तयति । देवलोकमेव तेन जयति । उदीचीमावृत्य दोग्धि । मनुष्यलोकमेव तेन जयति । पूर्वौ दुह्याज्ज्येष्ठस्य ज्यैष्ठिनेयस्य । यो वा गतश्रीः स्यात् । अपरौ दुह्यात्कनिष्ठस्य कानिष्ठिनेयस्य । यो वा बुभूषेत्
2.1.8.m: He lets [the calf] loose from the south: / he thereby wins the world of the fathers. / He turns [the cow] toward the east: / he thereby wins the world of the gods. / Having turned her toward the north, he milks [her]: / he thereby wins the world of men. / One should milk the two front [teats] for the eldest son of the first wife, / or for one who has attained prosperity. / One should milk the two rear [teats] for the youngest son of the youngest wife, / or for one who desires to become [prosperous].

2.1.8.s: na saṃmṛśati | pāpavasyasasya vyāvṛttyai | vāyavyaṃ vā etadupasṛṣṭam | āśvinaṃ duhyamānam | maitraṃ dugdham | aryamṇa udvāsyamānam | tvāṣṭramunnīyamānam | bṛhaspaterunnītam | savituḥ prakrāntam | dyāvāpṛthivyagg hriyamāṇam
2.1.8.d: न संमृशति । पापवस्यसस्य व्यावृत्त्यै । वायव्यं वा एतदुपसृष्टम् । आश्विनं दुह्यमानम् । मैत्रं दुग्धम् । अर्यम्ण उद्वास्यमानम् । त्वाष्ट्रमुन्नीयमानम् । बृहस्पतेरुन्नीतम् । सवितुः प्रक्रान्तम् । द्यावापृथिव्यग्ग् ह्रियमाणम्
2.1.8.m: He does not touch [them together], / to keep the worse and the better separated. / Belonging to Vāyu indeed is this [milk] when let loose; / belonging to the Aśvins when being milked; / belonging to Mitra when milked; / belonging to Aryaman when being removed [from the fire]; / belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ when being ladled out; / belonging to Bṛhaspati when ladled out; / belonging to Savitṛ when stepped forward; / belonging to heaven and earth when being carried;

2.1.8.s: aindrāgnamupasāditam | sarvābhyo vā eṣa devatābhyo juhoti | yo'gnihotraṃ juhoti | yathā khalu vai dhenuṃ tīrthe tarpayati | evamagnihotrī yajamānaṃ tarpayati | tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ | pra suvargaṃ lokaṃ jānāti | paśyati putram | paśyati pautram | pra prajayā paśubhirmithunairjāyate | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo'gnihotraṃ juhvati | ya u cainadevaṃ veda
2.1.8.d: ऐन्द्राग्नमुपसादितम् । सर्वाभ्यो वा एष देवताभ्यो जुहोति । योऽग्निहोत्रं जुहोति । यथा खलु वै धेनुं तीर्थे तर्पयति । एवमग्निहोत्री यजमानं तर्पयति । तृप्यति प्रजया पशुभिः । प्र सुवर्गं लोकं जानाति । पश्यति पुत्रम् । पश्यति पौत्रम् । प्र प्रजया पशुभिर्मिथुनैर्जायते । यस्यैवं विदुषोऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वति । य उ चैनदेवं वेद
2.1.8.m: belonging to Indra and Agni when set down. / To all the deities indeed he offers / who offers the Agnihotra. / Just as one satisfies a cow at a watering place, / so the Agnihotra-cow satisfies the sacrificer. / He is satisfied with offspring and domestic animals; / he knows the heavenly realm; / he sees a son; / he sees a grandson; / he propagates with offspring, domestic animals, and pairs— / for whom, knowing thus, they offer the Agnihotra, / and who knows it thus.

2.1.9.s: trayo vai praiyamedhā āsan | teṣāṃ trireko'gnihotramajuhot | dvirekaḥ | sakṛdekaḥ | teṣāṃ yastrirajuhot | sa ṛcā'juhot | yo dviḥ | sa yajuṣā | yaḥ sakṛt | sa tūṣṇīm
2.1.9.d: त्रयो वै प्रैयमेधा आसन् । तेषां त्रिरेकोऽग्निहोत्रमजुहोत् । द्विरेकः । सकृदेकः । तेषां यस्त्रिरजुहोत् । स ऋचाऽजुहोत् । यो द्विः । स यजुषा । यः सकृत् । स तूष्णीम्
2.1.9.m: There were three Priyamedhas. / Among them, one offered the Agnihotra three times, / one twice, / one once. / Among them, he who offered three times / offered with a ṛc; / he who [offered] twice, / with a yajus; / he who [offered] once, / silently.

2.1.9.s: yaśca yajuṣā'juhodyaśca tūṣṇīm | tāvubhāvārdhnutām | tasmādyajuṣā''hutiḥ pūrvā hotavyā | tūṣṇīmuttarā | ubhe evarddhī avarundhe | agnirjyotirjyotiragniḥ svāheti sāyaṃ juhoti | reta eva taddadhāti | sūryo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāheti prātaḥ | reta eva hitaṃ prajanayati | reto vā etasya hitaṃ na prajāyate
2.1.9.d: यश्च यजुषाऽजुहोद्यश्च तूष्णीम् । तावुभावार्ध्नुताम् । तस्माद्यजुषा'ऽहुतिः पूर्वा होतव्या । तूष्णीमुत्तरा । उभे एवर्द्धी अवरुन्धे । अग्निर्ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरग्निः स्वाहेति सायं जुहोति । रेत एव तद्दधाति । सूर्यो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिः सूर्यः स्वाहेति प्रातः । रेत एव हितं प्रजनयति । रेतो वा एतस्य हितं न प्रजायते
2.1.9.m: And both he who offered with a yajus and he who [offered] silently prospered. / Therefore the first oblation is to be offered with a yajus, / the second silently. / He secures both forms of prosperity. / 'Agni is light, light is Agni, svāhā,' thus he offers in the evening. / He thereby deposits seed. / 'Sūrya is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā,' thus in the morning. / He brings to birth the seed that has been deposited. / The seed deposited for him is not brought to birth [otherwise]—

2.1.9.s: yasyāgnihotramahutaṃ sūryo'bhyudeti | yadyante syāt | unnīya prāṅudādravet | sa upasādyātamitorāsīta | sa yadā tāmyet | atha bhūḥ svāheti juhuyāt | prajāpatirvai bhūtaḥ | tamevopāsarat | sa evainaṃ tata unnayati | nārtimārcchati yajamānaḥ
2.1.9.d: यस्याग्निहोत्रमहुतं सूर्योऽभ्युदेति । यद्यन्ते स्यात् । उन्नीय प्राङुदाद्रवेत् । स उपसाद्यातमितोरासीत । स यदा ताम्येत् । अथ भूः स्वाहेति जुहुयात् । प्रजापतिर्वै भूतः । तमेवोपासरत् । स एवैनं तत उन्नयति । नार्तिमार्च्छति यजमानः
2.1.9.m: [for him] upon whose agnihotra, when unoffered, the sun rises. / If it should be near [at hand], / having drawn it out, he should run forth toward the east. / Having placed it down, he should sit until fainting. / When he faints, / then he should offer [saying], 'Bhūḥ, svāhā.' / Prajāpati, indeed, became [that]. / He approaches him indeed. / He brings him up from that; / the sacrificer suffers no affliction.

2.1.10.s: yadagnimuddharati | vasavastarhyagniḥ | tasmin yasya tathāvidhe juhvati | vasuṣvevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | nihito dhūpāyañchete | rudrāstarhyagniḥ | tasmin yasya tathāvidhe juhvati | rudreṣvevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | prathamamidhmamarcirālabhate | ādityāstarhyagniḥ
2.1.10.d: यदग्निमुद्धरति । वसवस्तर्ह्यग्निः । तस्मिन् यस्य तथाविधे जुह्वति । वसुष्वेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति । निहितो धूपायञ्छेते । रुद्रास्तर्ह्यग्निः । तस्मिन् यस्य तथाविधे जुह्वति । रुद्रेष्वेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति । प्रथममिध्ममर्चिरालभते । आदित्यास्तर्ह्यग्निः
2.1.10.m:
When he lifts up the fire, / then the fire is the Vasus. / In it, being such, when they offer for him, / his agnihotra becomes offered in the Vasus. / Laid down, it lies smoldering; / then the fire is the Rudras. / In it, being such, when they offer for him, / his agnihotra becomes offered in the Rudras. / The flame first touches the kindling-stick; / then the fire is the Ādityas.

In it, being such, when they offer for him, / his agnihotra becomes offered in the Ādityas. / The kindling-stick is completely blazing all over; / then the fire is the Viśve Devas. / In it, being such, when they offer for him, / his agnihotra becomes offered in the Viśve Devas. / The flame sinks low, becoming reddish, as it were; / then the fire is Indra. / In it, being such, when they offer for him, / his agnihotra becomes offered in Indra.

2.1.10.s: tasmin yasya tathāvidhe juhvati | ādityeṣvevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | sarva eva sarvaśa idhma ādīpto bhavati | viśve devāstarhyagniḥ | tasmin yasya tathāvidhe juhvati | viśveṣvevāsya deveṣvagnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | nitarāmarcirupāvaiti lohinīkeva bhavati | indrastarhyagniḥ | tasmin yasya tathāvidhe juhvati | indra evāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati
2.1.10.d: तस्मिन् यस्य तथाविधे जुह्वति । आदित्येष्वेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति । सर्व एव सर्वश इध्म आदीप्तो भवति । विश्वे देवास्तर्ह्यग्निः । तस्मिन् यस्य तथाविधे जुह्वति । विश्वेष्वेवास्य देवेष्वग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति । नितरामर्चिरुपावैति लोहिनीकेव भवति । इन्द्रस्तर्ह्यग्निः । तस्मिन् यस्य तथाविधे जुह्वति । इन्द्र एवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति

2.1.10.s: aṅgārā bhavanti | tebhyo'ṅgārebhyo'rcirudeti | prajāpatistarhyagniḥ | tasmin yasya tathāvidhe juhvati | prajāpatāvevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | śaro'ṅgārā adhyūhante | brahma tarhyagniḥ | tasmin yasya tathāvidhe juhvati | brahmannevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | vasuṣu rudreṣvādityeṣu viśveṣu deveṣu | indre prajāpatau brahman | aparivargamevāsyaitāsu devatāsu hutaṃ bhavati | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo'gnihotraṃ juhvati | ya u cainadevaṃ veda
2.1.10.d: अङ्गारा भवन्ति । तेभ्योऽङ्गारेभ्योऽर्चिरुदेति । प्रजापतिस्तर्ह्यग्निः । तस्मिन् यस्य तथाविधे जुह्वति । प्रजापतावेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति । शरोऽङ्गारा अध्यूहन्ते । ब्रह्म तर्ह्यग्निः । तस्मिन् यस्य तथाविधे जुह्वति । ब्रह्मन्नेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति । वसुषु रुद्रेष्वादित्येषु विश्वेषु देवेषु । इन्द्रे प्रजापतौ ब्रह्मन् । अपरिवर्गमेवास्यैतासु देवतासु हुतं भवति । यस्यैवं विदुषोऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वति । य उ चैनदेवं वेद
2.1.10.m: There are glowing coals; / from those glowing coals flame rises up; / then the fire is Prajāpati. / In it, being such, when they offer for him, / his agnihotra becomes offered in Prajāpati. / Coals covered with ash are gathered up; / then the fire is the brahman. / In it, being such, when they offer for him, / his agnihotra becomes offered in the brahman. / In the Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas, the Viśve Devas, / in Indra, in Prajāpati, in the brahman— / without any omission indeed it becomes offered for him in these deities, / for him who knows thus when they offer the agnihotra, / and who knows it thus.

2.1.11.s: ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmīti sāyaṃ pariṣiñcati | satyaṃ tvartena pariṣiñcāmīti prātaḥ | agnirvā ṛtam | asāvādityaḥ satyam | agnimeva tadādityena sāyaṃ pariṣiñcati | agninā''dityaṃ prātaḥ saḥ | yāvadahorātre bhavataḥ | tāvadasya lokasya | nārtirna riṣṭiḥ | nānto na paryanto'sti | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo'gnihotraṃ juhvati | ya u cainadevaṃ veda
2.1.11.d: ऋतं त्वा सत्येन परिषिञ्चामीति सायं परिषिञ्चति । सत्यं त्वर्तेन परिषिञ्चामीति प्रातः । अग्निर्वा ऋतम् । असावादित्यः सत्यम् । अग्निमेव तदादित्येन सायं परिषिञ्चति । अग्निना'ऽदित्यं प्रातः सः । यावदहोरात्रे भवतः । तावदस्य लोकस्य । नार्तिर्न रिष्टिः । नान्तो न पर्यन्तोऽस्ति । यस्यैवं विदुषोऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वति । य उ चैनदेवं वेद
2.1.11.m: 'I sprinkle around you, the cosmic order, with truth,' thus he sprinkles around in the evening. / 'I sprinkle around you, the truth, with cosmic order,' thus in the morning. / Agni, indeed, is cosmic order; / that sun is truth. / He thereby sprinkles around Agni with the sun in the evening; / he [sprinkles around] the sun with Agni in the morning. / As long as day and night exist, / so long, for this world of his, / there is neither affliction nor harm, / neither end nor boundary, / for him who knows thus when they offer the agnihotra, / and who knows it thus.

2.2.1.s: prajāpatirakāmayata prajāḥ sṛjeyeti | sa etaṃ daśahotāramapaśyat | taṃ manasā'nudrutya darbhastambe'juhot | tato vai sa prajā asṛjata | tā asmāthsṛṣṭā apākrāman | tā graheṇāgṛhṇāt | tadgrahasya grahatvam | yaḥ kāmayeta prajāyeyeti | sa daśahotāraṃ manasā'nudrutya darbhastambe juhuyāt | prajāpatirvai daśahotā
2.2.1.d: प्रजापतिरकामयत प्रजाः सृजेयेति । स एतं दशहोतारमपश्यत् । तं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्य दर्भस्तम्बेऽजुहोत् । ततो वै स प्रजा असृजत । ता अस्माथ्सृष्टा अपाक्रामन् । ता ग्रहेणागृह्णात् । तद्ग्रहस्य ग्रहत्वम् । यः कामयेत प्रजायेयेति । स दशहोतारं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्य दर्भस्तम्बे जुहुयात् । प्रजापतिर्वै दशहोता
2.2.1.m: Prajāpati desired, 'May I bring forth offspring.' / He saw this daśahotṛ formula. / Having run through it with his mind, he offered in a clump of darbha grass. / Thence indeed he created offspring. / Having been created, they moved away from him. / He seized them with a cup. / That is the cup-nature of a cup. / Whoever might desire, 'May I bring forth offspring,' / he, having run through the daśahotṛ formula with his mind, should offer in a clump of darbha grass. / Prajāpati, indeed, is the daśahotṛ formula.

2.2.1.s: prajāpatireva bhūtvā prajāyate | manasā juhoti | mana iva hi prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | pūrṇayā juhoti | pūrṇa iva hi prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | nyūnayā juhoti | nyūnāddhi prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | prajānāṃ sṛṣṭyai
2.2.1.d: प्रजापतिरेव भूत्वा प्रजायते । मनसा जुहोति । मन इव हि प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । पूर्णया जुहोति । पूर्ण इव हि प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । न्यूनया जुहोति । न्यूनाद्धि प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । प्रजानां सृष्ट्यै
2.2.1.m: Becoming Prajāpati indeed, he brings forth offspring. / He offers with the mind; / for Prajāpati is mind-like, as it were; / [it is] for the attainment of Prajāpati. He offers with a full [spoon]; / for Prajāpati is full, as it were; / [it is] for the attainment of Prajāpati. / He offers with a deficient [spoon]; / for from the deficient Prajāpati created offspring; / [it is] for the creation of offspring.

2.2.1.s: darbhastambe juhoti | etasmādvai yoneḥ prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | yasmādeva yoneḥ prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tasmādeva yoneḥ prajāyate | brāhmaṇo dakṣiṇata upāste | brāhmaṇo vai prajānāmupadraṣṭā | upadraṣṭumatyeva prajāyate | graho bhavati | prajānāṃ sṛṣṭānāṃ dhṛtyai | yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vidyāṃ vidvāṃsaṃ yaśo narcchet
2.2.1.d: दर्भस्तम्बे जुहोति । एतस्माद्वै योनेः प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । यस्मादेव योनेः प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । तस्मादेव योनेः प्रजायते । ब्राह्मणो दक्षिणत उपास्ते । ब्राह्मणो वै प्रजानामुपद्रष्टा । उपद्रष्टुमत्येव प्रजायते । ग्रहो भवति । प्रजानां सृष्टानां धृत्यै । यं ब्राह्मणं विद्यां विद्वांसं यशो नर्च्छेत्
2.2.1.m: He offers in a clump of darbha grass. / From this womb, indeed, Prajāpati created offspring. / From that very womb from which Prajāpati created offspring, / he brings forth offspring. / A Brahmin sits nearby on the south. / The Brahmin, indeed, is the overseer of offspring. / It is with an overseer indeed that he brings forth offspring. / There is a cup / for the holding fast of the offspring that have been created. / Whom, a Brahmin knowing the lore, fame should not reach—

2.2.1.s: so'raṇyaṃ paretya | darbhastambamudgrathya | brāhmaṇaṃ dakṣiṇato niṣādya | caturhotṝnvyācakṣīta | etadvai devānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ brahma | yaccaturhotāraḥ | tadeva prakāśaṃ gamayati | tadenaṃ prakāśaṃ gatam | prakāśaṃ prajānāṃ gamayati | darbhastambamudgrathya vyācaṣṭe
2.2.1.d: सोऽरण्यं परेत्य । दर्भस्तम्बमुद्ग्रथ्य । ब्राह्मणं दक्षिणतो निषाद्य । चतुर्होतॄन्व्याचक्षीत । एतद्वै देवानां परमं गुह्यं ब्रह्म । यच्चतुर्होतारः । तदेव प्रकाशं गमयति । तदेनं प्रकाशं गतम् । प्रकाशं प्रजानां गमयति । दर्भस्तम्बमुद्ग्रथ्य व्याचष्टे
2.2.1.m: he, having gone out into the wilderness, / having tied up a clump of darbha grass, / having made a Brahmin sit on the south, / should recite the caturhotṛ formulas. / This, indeed, is the supreme secret brahman of the gods: / that which is the caturhotṛ formulas. / He brings it to light indeed. / Having come to light, it / brings him to the light of offspring. / Having tied up a clump of darbha grass, he recites.

2.2.1.s: agnivān vai darbhastambaḥ | agnivatyeva vyācaṣṭe | brāhmaṇo dakṣiṇata upāste | brāhmaṇo vai prajānāmupadraṣṭā | upadraṣṭumatyevainaṃ yaśa ṛcchati | īśvaraṃ taṃ yaśo'rtorityāhuḥ | yasyānte vyācaṣṭa iti | varastasmai deyaḥ | yadevainaṃ tatropanamati | tadevāvarundhe
2.2.1.d: अग्निवान् वै दर्भस्तम्बः । अग्निवत्येव व्याचष्टे । ब्राह्मणो दक्षिणत उपास्ते । ब्राह्मणो वै प्रजानामुपद्रष्टा । उपद्रष्टुमत्येवैनं यश ऋच्छति । ईश्वरं तं यशोऽर्तोरित्याहुः । यस्यान्ते व्याचष्ट इति । वरस्तस्मै देयः । यदेवैनं तत्रोपनमति । तदेवावरुन्धे
2.2.1.m: Possessed of fire, indeed, is a clump of darbha grass. / In that which is possessed of fire he recites. / A Brahmin sits nearby on the south. / The Brahmin, indeed, is the overseer of offspring. / With an overseer indeed fame reaches him. / 'Fame is capable of going to him,' they say, / 'in whose presence they recite for you.' / A boon is to be given to him. / Whatever falls to his lot there, / that indeed he secures.

2.2.1.s: agnimādadhāno daśahotrā'raṇimavadadhyāt | prajātamevainamādhatte | tenaivoddrutyāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt | prajātamevainajjuhoti | havirnirvapsyandaśahotāraṃ vyācakṣīta | prajātamevainaṃ nirvapati | sāmidhenīranuvakṣyandaśahotāraṃ vyācakṣīta | sāmidhenīreva sṛṣṭvā''rabhya pratanute | atho yajño vai daśahotā | yajñameva tanute
2.2.1.d: अग्निमादधानो दशहोत्राऽरणिमवदध्यात् । प्रजातमेवैनमाधत्ते । तेनैवोद्द्रुत्याग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् । प्रजातमेवैनज्जुहोति । हविर्निर्वप्स्यन्दशहोतारं व्याचक्षीत । प्रजातमेवैनं निर्वपति । सामिधेनीरनुवक्ष्यन्दशहोतारं व्याचक्षीत । सामिधेनीरेव सृष्ट्वा'ऽरभ्य प्रतनुते । अथो यज्ञो वै दशहोता । यज्ञमेव तनुते
2.2.1.m: Establishing the fire, he should deposit the fire-drill with the daśahotṛ formula. / As already born indeed he establishes it. / Having run up with that alone, he should offer the agnihotra. / As already born indeed he offers it. / Intending to apportion the oblation-material, he should recite the daśahotṛ formula. / As already born indeed he apportions it. / Intending to recite the kindling verses, he should recite the daśahotṛ formula. / Having created the kindling verses, having grasped [them], he extends [them]. / Moreover, the daśahotṛ formula, indeed, is the sacrifice. / He extends the sacrifice indeed.

2.2.1.s: abhicarandaśahotāraṃ juhuyāt | nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ | nābhirdaśamī | saprāṇamevainamabhicarati | etāvadvai puruṣasya svam | yāvatprāṇāḥ | yāvadevāsyāsti | tadabhicarati | svakṛta iriṇe juhoti pradare vā | etadvā asyai nirṛtigṛhītam | nirṛtigṛhīta evainaṃ nirṛtyā grāhayati | yadvācaḥ krūram | tena vaṣaṭkaroti | vāca evainaṃ krūreṇa pravṛścati | tājagārtimārcchati
2.2.1.d: अभिचरन्दशहोतारं जुहुयात् । नव वै पुरुषे प्राणाः । नाभिर्दशमी । सप्राणमेवैनमभिचरति । एतावद्वै पुरुषस्य स्वम् । यावत्प्राणाः । यावदेवास्यास्ति । तदभिचरति । स्वकृत इरिणे जुहोति प्रदरे वा । एतद्वा अस्यै निरृतिगृहीतम् । निरृतिगृहीत एवैनं निरृत्या ग्राहयति । यद्वाचः क्रूरम् । तेन वषट्करोति । वाच एवैनं क्रूरेण प्रवृश्चति । ताजगार्तिमार्च्छति
2.2.1.m: Practicing sorcery, he should offer the daśahotṛ formula. / Nine, indeed, are the breaths in a man; / the navel is the tenth. / Together with the breaths indeed he practices sorcery against him. / Such, indeed, is a man's own [property], / as are the breaths. / As much as is his, / against that he practices sorcery. / He offers in a natural cleft or in a fissure. / For this [spot] of this [earth] is seized by Nirṛti. / In that which is seized by Nirṛti, he causes Nirṛti to seize him. / What is cruel in speech, / with that he utters the vaṣaṭ-call. / With the cruel [part] of speech he cuts him off; / immediately he goes to ruin.

2.2.2.s: prajāpatirakāmayata darśapūrṇamāsau sṛjeyeti | sa etaṃ caturhotāramapaśyat | taṃ manasā'nudrutyāhavanīye'juhot | tato vai sa darśapūrṇamāsāvasṛjata | tāvasmāthsṛṣṭāvapākrāmatām | tau graheṇāgṛhṇāt | tadgrahasya grahatvam | darśapūrṇamāsāvālabhamānaḥ | caturhotāraṃ manasā'nudrutyāhavanīye juhuyāt | darśapūrṇamāsāveva sṛṣṭvā''rabhya pratanute
2.2.2.d: प्रजापतिरकामयत दर्शपूर्णमासौ सृजेयेति । स एतं चतुर्होतारमपश्यत् । तं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्याहवनीयेऽजुहोत् । ततो वै स दर्शपूर्णमासावसृजत । तावस्माथ्सृष्टावपाक्रामताम् । तौ ग्रहेणागृह्णात् । तद्ग्रहस्य ग्रहत्वम् । दर्शपूर्णमासावालभमानः । चतुर्होतारं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्याहवनीये जुहुयात् । दर्शपूर्णमासावेव सृष्ट्वा'ऽरभ्य प्रतनुते
2.2.2.m: Prajāpati desired: 'May I create the New and Full Moon sacrifices.' / He saw this Caturhotṛ formula. / Having recited it in mind, he offered it in the Āhavanīya fire. / Thereupon he indeed created the New and Full Moon sacrifices. / Created, they departed from him. / He grasped them with a cup. / That is the cup-nature of the cup. / Undertaking the New and Full Moon sacrifices, / one should, having recited the Caturhotṛ formula in mind, offer it in the Āhavanīya fire. / Having created the New and Full Moon sacrifices, having taken hold of them, he extends them.

2.2.2.s: graho bhavati | darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sṛṣṭayordhṛtyai | so'kāmayata cāturmāsyāni sṛjeyeti | sa etaṃ pañcahotāramapaśyat | taṃ manasā'nudrutyāhavanīye'juhot | tato vai sa cāturmāsyānyasṛjata | tānyasmāthsṛṣṭānyapākrāman | tāni graheṇāgṛhṇāt | tadgrahasya grahatvam | cāturmāsyānyālabhamānaḥ
2.2.2.d: ग्रहो भवति । दर्शपूर्णमासयोः सृष्टयोर्धृत्यै । सोऽकामयत चातुर्मास्यानि सृजेयेति । स एतं पञ्चहोतारमपश्यत् । तं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्याहवनीयेऽजुहोत् । ततो वै स चातुर्मास्यान्यसृजत । तान्यस्माथ्सृष्टान्यपाक्रामन् । तानि ग्रहेणागृह्णात् । तद्ग्रहस्य ग्रहत्वम् । चातुर्मास्यान्यालभमानः
2.2.2.m: It becomes a cup / for the upholding of the New and Full Moon sacrifices when created. / He desired: 'May I create the Four-Month sacrifices.' / He saw this Pañcahotṛ formula. / Having recited it in mind, he offered it in the Āhavanīya fire. / Thereupon he indeed created the Four-Month sacrifices. / Created, they departed from him. / He grasped them with a cup. / That is the cup-nature of the cup. / Undertaking the Four-Month sacrifices,

2.2.2.s: pañcahotāraṃ manasā'nudrutyāhavanīye juhuyāt | cāturmāsyānyeva sṛṣṭvā''rabhya pratanute | graho bhavati | cāturmāsyānāṃ sṛṣṭānāṃ dhṛtyai | so'kāmayata paśubandhaṃ sṛjeyeti | sa etaṃ ṣaḍḍhotāramapaśyat | taṃ manasā'nudrutyāhavanīye'juhot | tato vai sa paśubandhamasṛjata | so'smāthsṛṣṭo'pākrāmat | taṃ graheṇāgṛhṇāt
2.2.2.d: पञ्चहोतारं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्याहवनीये जुहुयात् । चातुर्मास्यान्येव सृष्ट्वा'ऽरभ्य प्रतनुते । ग्रहो भवति । चातुर्मास्यानां सृष्टानां धृत्यै । सोऽकामयत पशुबन्धं सृजेयेति । स एतं षड्ढोतारमपश्यत् । तं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्याहवनीयेऽजुहोत् । ततो वै स पशुबन्धमसृजत । सोऽस्माथ्सृष्टोऽपाक्रामत् । तं ग्रहेणागृह्णात्
2.2.2.m: one should, having recited the Pañcahotṛ formula in mind, offer it in the Āhavanīya fire. / Having created the Four-Month sacrifices, having taken hold of them, he extends them. / It becomes a cup / for the upholding of the Four-Month sacrifices when created. / He desired: 'May I create the animal sacrifice.' / He saw this Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula. / Having recited it in mind, he offered it in the Āhavanīya fire. / Thereupon he indeed created the animal sacrifice. / Created, it departed from him. / He grasped it with a cup.

2.2.2.s: tadgrahasya grahatvam | paśubandhena yakṣyamāṇaḥ | ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ manasā'nudrutyāhavanīye juhuyāt | paśubandhameva sṛṣṭvā''rabhya pratanute | graho bhavati | paśubandhasya sṛṣṭasya dhṛtyai | so'kāmayata saumyamadhvaraṃ sṛjeyeti | sa etaṃ saptahotāramapaśyat | taṃ manasā'nudrutyāhavanīye'juhot | tato vai sa saumyamadhvaramasṛjata
2.2.2.d: तद्ग्रहस्य ग्रहत्वम् । पशुबन्धेन यक्ष्यमाणः । षड्ढोतारं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्याहवनीये जुहुयात् । पशुबन्धमेव सृष्ट्वा'ऽरभ्य प्रतनुते । ग्रहो भवति । पशुबन्धस्य सृष्टस्य धृत्यै । सोऽकामयत सौम्यमध्वरं सृजेयेति । स एतं सप्तहोतारमपश्यत् । तं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्याहवनीयेऽजुहोत् । ततो वै स सौम्यमध्वरमसृजत
2.2.2.m: That is the cup-nature of the cup. / About to sacrifice with the animal sacrifice, / one should, having recited the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula in mind, offer it in the Āhavanīya fire. / Having created the animal sacrifice, having taken hold of them, he extends it. / It becomes a cup / for the upholding of the animal sacrifice when created. / He desired: 'May I create the Soma sacrifice.' / He saw this Saptahotṛ formula. / Having recited it in mind, he offered it in the Āhavanīya fire. / Thereupon he indeed created the Soma sacrifice.

2.2.2.s: so'smāthsṛṣṭo'pākrāmat | taṃ graheṇāgṛhṇāt | tadgrahasya grahatvam | dīkṣiṣyamāṇaḥ | saptahotāraṃ manasā'nudrutyāhavanīye juhuyāt | saumyamevādhvaraṃ sṛṣṭvā''rabhya pratanute | graho bhavati | saumyasyādhvarasya sṛṣṭasya dhṛtyai | devebhyo vai yajño na prābhavat | tametāvacchaḥ samabharan
2.2.2.d: सोऽस्माथ्सृष्टोऽपाक्रामत् । तं ग्रहेणागृह्णात् । तद्ग्रहस्य ग्रहत्वम् । दीक्षिष्यमाणः । सप्तहोतारं मनसाऽनुद्रुत्याहवनीये जुहुयात् । सौम्यमेवाध्वरं सृष्ट्वा'ऽरभ्य प्रतनुते । ग्रहो भवति । सौम्यस्याध्वरस्य सृष्टस्य धृत्यै । देवेभ्यो वै यज्ञो न प्राभवत् । तमेतावच्छः समभरन्
2.2.2.m: Created, it departed from him. / He grasped it with a cup. / That is the cup-nature of the cup. / About to undergo consecration, / one should, having recited the Saptahotṛ formula in mind, offer it in the Āhavanīya fire. / Having created the Soma sacrifice, having taken hold of it, he extends it. / It becomes a cup / for the upholding of the Soma sacrifice when created. / The sacrifice did not suffice for the gods; / they gathered it together in so many parts.

2.2.2.s: yathsaṃbhārāḥ | tato vai tebhyo yajñaḥ prābhavat | yathsaṃbhārā bhavanti | yajñasya prabhūtyai | ātithyamāsādya vyācaṣṭe | yajñamukhaṃ vā ātithyam | mukhata eva yajñaṃ saṃbhṛtya pratanute | ayajño vā eṣaḥ | yo'patnīkaḥ | na prajāḥ prajāyeran | patnīrvyācaṣṭe | yajñamevākaḥ | prajānāṃ prajananāya | upasathsu vyācaṣṭe | etadvai patnīnāmāyatanam | sva evainā āyatane'vakalpayati
2.2.2.d: यथ्संभाराः । ततो वै तेभ्यो यज्ञः प्राभवत् । यथ्संभारा भवन्ति । यज्ञस्य प्रभूत्यै । आतिथ्यमासाद्य व्याचष्टे । यज्ञमुखं वा आतिथ्यम् । मुखत एव यज्ञं संभृत्य प्रतनुते । अयज्ञो वा एषः । योऽपत्नीकः । न प्रजाः प्रजायेरन् । पत्नीर्व्याचष्टे । यज्ञमेवाकः । प्रजानां प्रजननाय । उपसथ्सु व्याचष्टे । एतद्वै पत्नीनामायतनम् । स्व एवैना आयतनेऽवकल्पयति
2.2.2.m: That there are ritual requisites, / thereupon the sacrifice sufficed for them. / That there are ritual requisites / is for the sufficiency of the sacrifice. / Having set down the guest-offering, he explains [the formulas]. / The guest-offering is the face of the sacrifice. / Right from the face, having collected the sacrifice, he extends it. / Non-sacrifice indeed is this / which is without a wife. / Offspring would not be produced. / He explains the wives [of the gods]; / he has indeed made it a sacrifice / for the generation of offspring. / He explains during the Upasad rites; / this indeed is the proper place of the wives. / In their own proper place he accommodates them.

2.2.3.s: prajāpatirakāmayata prajāyeyeti | sa tapo'tapyata | sa trivṛtagg stomamasṛjata | taṃ pañcadaśastomo madhyata udatṛṇat | tau pūrvapakṣaścāparapakṣaścābhavatām | pūrvapakṣaṃ devā anvasṛjyanta | aparapakṣamanvasurāḥ | tato devā abhavan | parā'surāḥ | yaṃ kāmayeta vasīyānthsyāditi
2.2.3.d: प्रजापतिरकामयत प्रजायेयेति । स तपोऽतप्यत । स त्रिवृतग्ग् स्तोममसृजत । तं पञ्चदशस्तोमो मध्यत उदतृणत् । तौ पूर्वपक्षश्चापरपक्षश्चाभवताम् । पूर्वपक्षं देवा अन्वसृज्यन्त । अपरपक्षमन्वसुराः । ततो देवा अभवन् । पराऽसुराः । यं कामयेत वसीयान्थ्स्यादिति
2.2.3.m: Prajāpati desired: 'May I bring forth offspring.' / He performed ascetic heat. / He created the ninefold chant. / The fifteenfold chant split it through the middle. / They became the waxing fortnight and the waning fortnight. / Following the waxing fortnight the gods were created, / following the waning fortnight the asuras. / Thereupon the gods prospered, / the asuras perished. / The one whom he might desire: 'May he be more prosperous,'

2.2.3.s: taṃ pūrvapakṣe yājayet | vasīyāneva bhavati | yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyānthsyāditi | tamaparapakṣe yājayet | pāpīyāneva bhavati | tasmāt pūrvapakṣo'parapakṣāt karuṇyataraḥ | prajāpatirvai daśahotā | caturhotā pañcahotā | ṣaḍḍhotā saptahotā | ṛtavaḥ saṃvathsaraḥ
2.2.3.d: तं पूर्वपक्षे याजयेत् । वसीयानेव भवति । यं कामयेत पापीयान्थ्स्यादिति । तमपरपक्षे याजयेत् । पापीयानेव भवति । तस्मात् पूर्वपक्षोऽपरपक्षात् करुण्यतरः । प्रजापतिर्वै दशहोता । चतुर्होता पञ्चहोता । षड्ढोता सप्तहोता । ऋतवः संवथ्सरः
2.2.3.m: he should cause him to sacrifice during the waxing fortnight. / He indeed becomes more prosperous. / The one whom he might desire: 'May he be more wretched,' / he should cause him to sacrifice during the waning fortnight. / He indeed becomes more wretched. / Therefore the waxing fortnight is more compassionate than the waning fortnight. / Prajāpati is the Daśahotṛ formula, / the Caturhotṛ, the Pañcahotṛ, / the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ, the Saptahotṛ, / the seasons, the year,

2.2.3.s: prajāḥ paśava ime lokāḥ | ya evaṃ prajāpatiṃ bahorbhūyāṃsaṃ veda | bahoreva bhūyānbhavati || prajāpatirdevāsurānasṛjata | sa indramapi nāsṛjata | taṃ devā abruvan | indraṃ no janayeti | so'bravīt | yathā'haṃ yuṣmāṃstapasā'sṛkṣi | evamindraṃ janayadhvamiti
2.2.3.d: प्रजाः पशव इमे लोकाः । य एवं प्रजापतिं बहोर्भूयांसं वेद । बहोरेव भूयान्भवति ॥ प्रजापतिर्देवासुरानसृजत । स इन्द्रमपि नासृजत । तं देवा अब्रुवन् । इन्द्रं नो जनयेति । सोऽब्रवीत् । यथाऽहं युष्मांस्तपसाऽसृक्षि । एवमिन्द्रं जनयध्वमिति
2.2.3.m: offspring, domestic animals, these worlds. / He who thus knows Prajāpati to be greater than the many, / becomes indeed greater than the many. / Prajāpati created the gods and asuras. / He had not yet created Indra. / To him the gods said: / 'Bring forth Indra for us.' / He said: / 'Just as I created you through ascetic heat, / even so bring forth Indra!'

2.2.3.s: te tapo'tapyanta | ta ātmannindramapaśyan | tamabruvan | jāyasveti | so'bravīt | kiṃ bhāgadheyamabhi janiṣya iti | ṛtūnthsaṃvathsaram | prajāḥ paśūn | imān lokānityabruvan | taṃ vai mā''hutyā prajanayatetyabravīt
2.2.3.d: ते तपोऽतप्यन्त । त आत्मन्निन्द्रमपश्यन् । तमब्रुवन् । जायस्वेति । सोऽब्रवीत् । किं भागधेयमभि जनिष्य इति । ऋतून्थ्संवथ्सरम् । प्रजाः पशून् । इमान् लोकानित्यब्रुवन् । तं वै मा'ऽहुत्या प्रजनयतेत्यब्रवीत्
2.2.3.m: They performed ascetic heat. / They saw Indra within themselves. / To him they said: / 'Be born!' / He said: / 'For what portion shall I be born?' / 'The seasons, the year, / offspring, domestic animals, / these worlds,' they said. / 'Generate me indeed with an oblation,' he said.

2.2.3.s: taṃ caturhotrā prājanayan | yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeteti | sa caturhotāraṃ juhuyāt | prajāpatirvai caturhotā | prajāpatireva bhūtvā prajāyate | jajanadindramindriyāya svāheti graheṇa juhoti | ā'sya vīro jāyate | vīraṃ hi devā etayā''hutyā prājanayan | ādityāścāṃgirasaśca suvarge loke'spardhanta | vayaṃ pūrve suvargaṃ lokamiyāma vayaṃ pūrva iti
2.2.3.d: तं चतुर्होत्रा प्राजनयन् । यः कामयेत वीरो म आजायेतेति । स चतुर्होतारं जुहुयात् । प्रजापतिर्वै चतुर्होता । प्रजापतिरेव भूत्वा प्रजायते । जजनदिन्द्रमिन्द्रियाय स्वाहेति ग्रहेण जुहोति । आऽस्य वीरो जायते । वीरं हि देवा एतया'ऽहुत्या प्राजनयन् । आदित्याश्चांगिरसश्च सुवर्गे लोकेऽस्पर्धन्त । वयं पूर्वे सुवर्गं लोकमियाम वयं पूर्व इति
2.2.3.m: They generated him with the Caturhotṛ formula. / He who should desire: 'May a hero be born to me,' / should offer the Caturhotṛ formula. / Prajāpati is the Caturhotṛ formula; / having indeed become Prajāpati, he reproduces. / With the cup he offers: 'May he generate Indra for power, svāhā!' / A hero is born to him; / for with this oblation the gods generated a hero. / The Ādityas and the Aṅgirases contended for the heavenly realm: / 'May we go first to the heavenly realm, may we [go] first!'

2.2.3.s: ta ādityā etaṃ pañcahotāramapaśyan | taṃ purā prātaranuvākādāgnīdhre'juhavuḥ | tato vai te pūrve suvargaṃ lokamāyan | yaḥ suvargakāmaḥ syāt | sa pañcahotāraṃ purā prātaranuvākādāgnīdhre juhuyāt | saṃvathsaro vai pañcahotā | saṃvathsaraḥ suvargo lokaḥ | saṃvathsara evartuṣu pratiṣṭhāya | suvargaṃ lokameti | te'bruvannaṃgirasa ādityān
2.2.3.d: त आदित्या एतं पञ्चहोतारमपश्यन् । तं पुरा प्रातरनुवाकादाग्नीध्रेऽजुहवुः । ततो वै ते पूर्वे सुवर्गं लोकमायन् । यः सुवर्गकामः स्यात् । स पञ्चहोतारं पुरा प्रातरनुवाकादाग्नीध्रे जुहुयात् । संवथ्सरो वै पञ्चहोता । संवथ्सरः सुवर्गो लोकः । संवथ्सर एवर्तुषु प्रतिष्ठाय । सुवर्गं लोकमेति । तेऽब्रुवन्नंगिरस आदित्यान्
2.2.3.m: Those Ādityas saw this Pañcahotṛ formula. / Before the morning recitation, they offered it in the Āgnīdhra fire. / Thereupon they went first to the heavenly realm. / He who is desirous of the heavenly realm / should offer the Pañcahotṛ formula in the Āgnīdhra fire before the morning recitation. / The year is the Pañcahotṛ formula; / the year is the heavenly realm. / Established in the year, in the seasons, / he goes to the heavenly realm. / Those Aṅgirases said to the Ādityas:

2.2.3.s: kva stha | kva vaḥ sadbhyo havyaṃ vakṣyāma iti | chandaḥsvityabruvan | gāyatriyāṃ triṣṭubhi jagatyāmiti | tasmācchandaḥsu sadbhya ādityebhyaḥ | āṃgīrasīḥ prajā havyaṃ vahanti | vahantyasmai prajā balim | ainamapratikhyātaṃ gacchati | ya evaṃ veda | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ | traya ime lokāḥ | asāvāditya ekaviṃśaḥ | etasminvā eṣa śritaḥ | etasminpratiṣṭhitaḥ | ya evametaṃ śritaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ veda | pratyeva tiṣṭhati
2.2.3.d: क्व स्थ । क्व वः सद्भ्यो हव्यं वक्ष्याम इति । छन्दःस्वित्यब्रुवन् । गायत्रियां त्रिष्टुभि जगत्यामिति । तस्माच्छन्दःसु सद्भ्य आदित्येभ्यः । आंगीरसीः प्रजा हव्यं वहन्ति । वहन्त्यस्मै प्रजा बलिम् । ऐनमप्रतिख्यातं गच्छति । य एवं वेद । द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः । त्रय इमे लोकाः । असावादित्य एकविंशः । एतस्मिन्वा एष श्रितः । एतस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितः । य एवमेतं श्रितं प्रतिष्ठितं वेद । प्रत्येव तिष्ठति
2.2.3.m: 'Where are you? / Where, to you being [there], shall we convey the offering?' / 'In the meters,' they said, / 'in the Gāyatrī, in the Triṣṭubh, in the Jagatī.' / Therefore to the Ādityas being in the meters, / the Aṅgiras offspring convey the offering. / To him offspring convey tribute; / [fame] comes to him unrefuted, / who knows thus. / Twelve months, five seasons, / these three worlds; / that sun is the twenty-first. / Upon him this [universe] is supported; / in him it is established. / He who knows him thus supported, established, / firmly stands.

2.2.4.s: prajāpatirakāmayata prajāyeyeti | sa etaṃ daśahotāramapaśyat | tena daśadhā''tmānaṃ vidhāya | daśahotrā'tapyata | tasya cittiḥ srugāsīt | cittamājyam | tasyaitāvatyeva vāgāsīt | etāvān yajñakratuḥ | sa caturhotāramasṛjata | so'nandat
2.2.4.d: प्रजापतिरकामयत प्रजायेयेति । स एतं दशहोतारमपश्यत् । तेन दशधा'ऽत्मानं विधाय । दशहोत्राऽतप्यत । तस्य चित्तिः स्रुगासीत् । चित्तमाज्यम् । तस्यैतावत्येव वागासीत् । एतावान् यज्ञक्रतुः । स चतुर्होतारमसृजत । सोऽनन्दत्
2.2.4.m: Prajāpati desired, 'May I be propagated.' / He saw this Daśahotṛ formula. / Having divided himself tenfold by means of it, / he performed tapas with the Daśahotṛ formula. / His insight was the ladle, / thought was the clarified butter. / His speech was only of this extent; / of this extent was the sacrificial intention. / He created the Caturhotṛ formula. / He rejoiced:

2.2.4.s: asṛkṣi vā imamiti | tasya somo havirāsīt | sa caturhotrā'tapyata | so'tāmyat | sa bhūriti vyāharat | sa bhūmimasṛjata | agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau yajūṃṣi | sa dvitīyamatapyata | so'tāmyat | sa bhuva iti vyāharat
2.2.4.d: असृक्षि वा इममिति । तस्य सोमो हविरासीत् । स चतुर्होत्राऽतप्यत । सोऽताम्यत् । स भूरिति व्याहरत् । स भूमिमसृजत । अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासौ यजूंषि । स द्वितीयमतप्यत । सोऽताम्यत् । स भुव इति व्याहरत्
2.2.4.m: 'Indeed, I have created this [one].' / Soma was his oblation. / He performed tapas with the Caturhotṛ formula. / He became faint. / He uttered, 'Bhūḥ!' / He created the earth, / the agnihotra, the new- and full-moon sacrifices, and the yajus formulas. / He performed tapas a second time. / He became faint. / He uttered, 'Bhuvaḥ!'

2.2.4.s: so'ntarikṣamasṛjata | cāturmāsyāni sāmāni | sa tṛtīyamatapyata | so'tāmyat | sa suvariti vyāharat | sa divamasṛjata | agniṣṭomamukthyamatirātramṛcaḥ | etā vai vyāhṛtaya ime lokāḥ | imānkhalu vai lokānanu prajāḥ paśavaśchandāṃsi prājāyanta | ya evametāḥ prajāpateḥ prathamā vyāhṛtīḥ prajātā veda
2.2.4.d: सोऽन्तरिक्षमसृजत । चातुर्मास्यानि सामानि । स तृतीयमतप्यत । सोऽताम्यत् । स सुवरिति व्याहरत् । स दिवमसृजत । अग्निष्टोममुक्थ्यमतिरात्रमृचः । एता वै व्याहृतय इमे लोकाः । इमान्खलु वै लोकाननु प्रजाः पशवश्छन्दांसि प्राजायन्त । य एवमेताः प्रजापतेः प्रथमा व्याहृतीः प्रजाता वेद
2.2.4.m: He created the intermediate space, / the seasonal sacrifices, and the sāmans. / He performed tapas a third time. / He became faint. / He uttered, 'Suvaḥ!' / He created heaven, / the agniṣṭoma, the ukthya, the atirātra, and the verses (ṛcs). / These mystical utterances are indeed these worlds. / Following these worlds indeed, offspring, domestic animals, and meters were propagated. / He who thus knows these first mystical utterances of Prajāpati to have been propagated—

2.2.4.s: pra prajayā paśubhirmithunairjāyate | sa pañcahotāramasṛjata | sa havirnāvindata | tasmai somastanuvaṃ prāyacchat | etatte haviriti | sa pañcahotrā'tapyata | so'tāmyat | sa pratyaṅṅabādhata | so'surānasṛjata | tadasyāpriyamāsīt
2.2.4.d: प्र प्रजया पशुभिर्मिथुनैर्जायते । स पञ्चहोतारमसृजत । स हविर्नाविन्दत । तस्मै सोमस्तनुवं प्रायच्छत् । एतत्ते हविरिति । स पञ्चहोत्राऽतप्यत । सोऽताम्यत् । स प्रत्यङ्ङबाधत । सोऽसुरानसृजत । तदस्याप्रियमासीत्
2.2.4.m: is propagated with offspring, domestic animals, and pairs. / He created the Pañcahotṛ formula. / He did not find an oblation. / Soma offered his own body to him, / saying, 'This is your oblation.' / He performed tapas with the Pañcahotṛ formula. / He became faint. / He exerted pressure downwards; / he created the asuras. / That was unpleasant to him.

2.2.4.s: taddurvarṇaṃ hiraṇyamabhavat | taddurvarṇasya hiraṇyasya janma | sa dvitīyamatapyata | so'tāmyat | sa prāṅabādhata | sa devānasṛjata | tadasya priyamāsīt | tathsuvarṇaṃ hiraṇyamabhavat | tathsuvarṇasya hiraṇyasya janma | ya evaṃ suvarṇasya hiraṇyasya janma veda
2.2.4.d: तद्दुर्वर्णं हिरण्यमभवत् । तद्दुर्वर्णस्य हिरण्यस्य जन्म । स द्वितीयमतप्यत । सोऽताम्यत् । स प्राङबाधत । स देवानसृजत । तदस्य प्रियमासीत् । तथ्सुवर्णं हिरण्यमभवत् । तथ्सुवर्णस्य हिरण्यस्य जन्म । य एवं सुवर्णस्य हिरण्यस्य जन्म वेद
2.2.4.m: That became base-colored gold (silver). / That is the origin of base-colored gold. / He performed tapas a second time. / He became faint. / He exerted pressure upwards; / he created the gods. / That was pleasant to him. / That became noble-colored gold. / That is the origin of noble-colored gold. / He who thus knows the origin of noble-colored gold—

2.2.4.s: suvarṇa ātmanā bhavati | durvarṇo'sya bhrātṛvyaḥ | tasmāthsuvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhāryam | suvarṇa eva bhavati | ainaṃ priyaṃ gacchati nāpriyam | sa saptahotāramasṛjata | sa saptahotraiva suvargaṃ lokamait | triṇavena stomenaibhyo lokebhyo'surānprāṇudata | trayastriṃśena pratyatiṣṭhat | ekaviṃśena rucamadhatta
2.2.4.d: सुवर्ण आत्मना भवति । दुर्वर्णोऽस्य भ्रातृव्यः । तस्माथ्सुवर्णं हिरण्यं भार्यम् । सुवर्ण एव भवति । ऐनं प्रियं गच्छति नाप्रियम् । स सप्तहोतारमसृजत । स सप्तहोत्रैव सुवर्गं लोकमैत् । त्रिणवेन स्तोमेनैभ्यो लोकेभ्योऽसुरान्प्राणुदत । त्रयस्त्रिंशेन प्रत्यतिष्ठत् । एकविंशेन रुचमधत्त
2.2.4.m: becomes noble-colored himself; / his rival becomes of base color. / Therefore noble-colored gold is to be worn. / He indeed becomes noble-colored; / what is pleasant comes to him, not what is unpleasant. / He created the Saptahotṛ formula. / By means of the Saptahotṛ formula alone he went to the heavenly realm. / With the twenty-seven-fold stoma he repelled the asuras from these worlds; / with the thirty-three-fold he became established; / with the twenty-one-fold he assumed brilliance.

2.2.4.s: saptadaśena prājāyata | ya evaṃ vidvānthsomena yajate | saptahotraiva suvargaṃ lokameti | triṇavena stomenaibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyānpraṇudate | trayastriṃśena pratitiṣṭhati | ekaviṃśena rucaṃ dhatte | saptadaśena prajāyate | tasmāthsaptadaśaḥ stomo na nirhṛtyaḥ | prajāpatirvai saptadaśaḥ | prajāpatimeva madhyato dhatte prajātyai
2.2.4.d: सप्तदशेन प्राजायत । य एवं विद्वान्थ्सोमेन यजते । सप्तहोत्रैव सुवर्गं लोकमेति । त्रिणवेन स्तोमेनैभ्यो लोकेभ्यो भ्रातृव्यान्प्रणुदते । त्रयस्त्रिंशेन प्रतितिष्ठति । एकविंशेन रुचं धत्ते । सप्तदशेन प्रजायते । तस्माथ्सप्तदशः स्तोमो न निर्हृत्यः । प्रजापतिर्वै सप्तदशः । प्रजापतिमेव मध्यतो धत्ते प्रजात्यै
2.2.4.m: With the seventeen-fold he was propagated. / He who, knowing thus, sacrifices with Soma / goes to the heavenly realm by the Saptahotṛ formula alone. / With the twenty-seven-fold stoma he repels rivals from these worlds; / with the thirty-three-fold he becomes established; / with the twenty-one-fold he assumes brilliance; / with the seventeen-fold he is propagated. / Therefore the seventeen-fold stoma is not to be removed. / Prajāpati is indeed seventeen-fold; / he places Prajāpati right in the middle for propagation.

2.2.5.s: devā vai varuṇamayājayan | sa yasyai yasyai devatāyai dakṣiṇāmanayat | tāmavlīnāt | te'bruvan | vyāvṛtya pratigṛhṇāma | tathā no dakṣiṇā na vleṣyatīti | te vyāvṛtya pratyagṛhṇan | tato vai tāndakṣiṇāṃ nāvlīnāt | ya evaṃ vidvānvyāvṛtya dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇāti | nainaṃ dakṣiṇā vlīnāti
2.2.5.d: देवा वै वरुणमयाजयन् । स यस्यै यस्यै देवतायै दक्षिणामनयत् । तामव्लीनात् । तेऽब्रुवन् । व्यावृत्य प्रतिगृह्णाम । तथा नो दक्षिणा न व्लेष्यतीति । ते व्यावृत्य प्रत्यगृह्णन् । ततो वै तान्दक्षिणां नाव्लीनात् । य एवं विद्वान्व्यावृत्य दक्षिणां प्रतिगृह्णाति । नैनं दक्षिणा व्लीनाति
2.2.5.m: The gods officiated at sacrifice for Varuṇa. / To whichever deity he led the sacrificial gift, / it crushed [that deity]. / They said, / 'Let us receive [it] by distinguishing [the deities], / so that the sacrificial gift will not crush us.' / They received [it] by distinguishing. / Then indeed the sacrificial gift did not crush them. / He who, knowing thus, receives a sacrificial gift by distinguishing— / the sacrificial gift does not crush him.

2.2.5.s: rājā tvā varuṇo nayatu devi dakṣiṇe'gnaye hiraṇyamityāha | āgneyaṃ vai hiraṇyam | svayaivainaddevatayā pratigṛhṇāti | somāya vāsa ityāha | saumyaṃ vai vāsaḥ | svayaivainaddevatayā pratigṛhṇāti | rudrāya gāmityāha | raudrī vai gauḥ | svayaivaināṃ devatayā pratigṛhṇāti | varuṇāyāśvamityāha
2.2.5.d: राजा त्वा वरुणो नयतु देवि दक्षिणेऽग्नये हिरण्यमित्याह । आग्नेयं वै हिरण्यम् । स्वयैवैनद्देवतया प्रतिगृह्णाति । सोमाय वास इत्याह । सौम्यं वै वासः । स्वयैवैनद्देवतया प्रतिगृह्णाति । रुद्राय गामित्याह । रौद्री वै गौः । स्वयैवैनां देवतया प्रतिगृह्णाति । वरुणायाश्वमित्याह
2.2.5.m: He says, 'May King Varuṇa lead you, O divine sacrificial gift: gold to Agni.' / Gold belongs to Agni. / Through its own deity he receives it. / He says, 'A garment to Soma.' / A garment belongs to Soma. / Through its own deity he receives it. / He says, 'A cow to Rudra.' / A cow belongs to Rudra. / Through its own deity he receives it. / He says, 'A horse to Varuṇa.'

2.2.5.s: vāruṇo vā aśvaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā pratigṛhṇāti | prājāpataye puruṣamityāha | prājāpatyo vai puruṣaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā pratigṛhṇāti | manave talpamityāha | mānavo vai talpaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā pratigṛhṇāti | uttānāyāṅgīrasāyāna ityāha | iyaṃ vā uttāna āṅgīrasaḥ
2.2.5.d: वारुणो वा अश्वः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया प्रतिगृह्णाति । प्राजापतये पुरुषमित्याह । प्राजापत्यो वै पुरुषः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया प्रतिगृह्णाति । मनवे तल्पमित्याह । मानवो वै तल्पः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया प्रतिगृह्णाति । उत्तानायाङ्गीरसायान इत्याह । इयं वा उत्तान आङ्गीरसः
2.2.5.m: A horse belongs to Varuṇa. / Through its own deity he receives it. / He says, 'A man to Prajāpati.' / A man belongs to Prajāpati. / Through its own deity he receives it. / He says, 'A couch to Manu.' / A couch belongs to Manu. / Through its own deity he receives it. / He says, 'A vehicle to Uttāna Āṅgirasa.' / This [earth] is indeed Uttāna Āṅgirasa.

2.2.5.s: anayaivainatprati gṛhṇāti | vaiśvānaryarcā rathaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | vaiśvānaro vai devatayā rathaḥ | svayaivainaṃ devatayā pratigṛhṇāti | tenāmṛtatvamaśyāmityāha | amṛtamevā''tmandhatte | vayo dātra ityāha | vaya evainaṃ kṛtvā | suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | mayo mahyamastu pratigrahītra ityāha
2.2.5.d: अनयैवैनत्प्रति गृह्णाति । वैश्वानर्यर्चा रथं प्रतिगृह्णाति । वैश्वानरो वै देवतया रथः । स्वयैवैनं देवतया प्रतिगृह्णाति । तेनामृतत्वमश्यामित्याह । अमृतमेवा'ऽत्मन्धत्ते । वयो दात्र इत्याह । वय एवैनं कृत्वा । सुवर्गं लोकं गमयति । मयो मह्यमस्तु प्रतिग्रहीत्र इत्याह
2.2.5.m: Through her alone he receives it. / He receives a chariot with a verse addressed to Vaiśvānara. / A chariot belongs to Vaiśvānara by deity. / Through its own deity he receives it. / He says, 'Through it may I attain immortality.' / He places immortality in himself. / He says, 'Vigor to the giver.' / Making it vigor, / he causes him to go to the heavenly realm. / He says, 'May there be pleasure for me, the receiver.'

2.2.5.s: yadvai śivam | tanmayaḥ | ātmana evaiṣā parīttiḥ | ka idaṃ kasmā adādityāha | prajāpatirvai kaḥ | sa prajāpataye dadāti | kāmaḥ kāmāyetyāha | kāmena hi dadāti | kāmena pratigṛhṇāti | kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītetyāha
2.2.5.d: यद्वै शिवम् । तन्मयः । आत्मन एवैषा परीत्तिः । क इदं कस्मा अदादित्याह । प्रजापतिर्वै कः । स प्रजापतये ददाति । कामः कामायेत्याह । कामेन हि ददाति । कामेन प्रतिगृह्णाति । कामो दाता कामः प्रतिग्रहीतेत्याह
2.2.5.m: What is auspicious, / that is pleasure. / That is the safe delivery of himself. / He says, 'Who has given this to whom?' / Ka is Prajāpati; / he gives to Prajāpati. / He says, 'Desire [gives] to desire.' / For with desire he gives; / with desire he receives. / He says, 'Desire is the giver, desire is the receiver.'

2.2.5.s: kāmo hi dātā | kāmaḥ pratigrahītā | kāmaṃ samudramāviśetyāha | samudra iva hi kāmaḥ | neva hi kāmasyānto'sti | na samudrasya | kāmena tvā pratigṛhṇāmītyāha | yena kāmena pratigṛhṇāti | sa evainamamuṣmiṃ lloke kāma āgacchati | kāmaitatta eṣā te kāma dakṣiṇetyāha | kāma eva tadyajamāno'muṣmiṃ lloke dakṣiṇāmicchati | na pratigrahītari | ya evaṃ vidvāndakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇāti | anṛṇāmevaināṃ pratigṛhṇāti
2.2.5.d: कामो हि दाता । कामः प्रतिग्रहीता । कामं समुद्रमाविशेत्याह । समुद्र इव हि कामः । नेव हि कामस्यान्तोऽस्ति । न समुद्रस्य । कामेन त्वा प्रतिगृह्णामीत्याह । येन कामेन प्रतिगृह्णाति । स एवैनममुष्मिं ल्लोके काम आगच्छति । कामैतत्त एषा ते काम दक्षिणेत्याह । काम एव तद्यजमानोऽमुष्मिं ल्लोके दक्षिणामिच्छति । न प्रतिग्रहीतरि । य एवं विद्वान्दक्षिणां प्रतिगृह्णाति । अनृणामेवैनां प्रतिगृह्णाति
2.2.5.m: For desire is the giver; / desire is the receiver. / He says, 'O desire, enter the ocean.' / For desire is like the ocean; / indeed there is no end to desire, / nor to the ocean. / He says, 'With desire I receive you.' / With whatever desire he receives it, / that very desire comes to him in yonder world. / He says, 'O desire, this is for you; this is your sacrificial gift, O desire.' / The sacrificer thus seeks the sacrificial gift in desire in yonder world, / not in the receiver. / He who, knowing thus, receives the sacrificial gift, / receives it free from debt.

2.2.6.s: anto vā eṣa yajñasya | yaddaśamamahaḥ | daśame'hanthsarparājñiyā ṛgbhiḥ stuvanti | yajñasyaivāntaṃ gatvā | annādyamavarundhate | tisṛbhiḥ stuvanti | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhya eva lokebhyo'nnādyamavarundhate | pṛśnivatīrbhavanti | annaṃ vai pṛśni
2.2.6.d: अन्तो वा एष यज्ञस्य । यद्दशममहः । दशमेऽहन्थ्सर्पराज्ञिया ऋग्भिः स्तुवन्ति । यज्ञस्यैवान्तं गत्वा । अन्नाद्यमवरुन्धते । तिसृभिः स्तुवन्ति । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एभ्य एव लोकेभ्योऽन्नाद्यमवरुन्धते । पृश्निवतीर्भवन्ति । अन्नं वै पृश्नि
2.2.6.m: This is the end of the sacrifice, / namely the tenth day. / On the tenth day they praise with the verses of the Serpent Queen. / Having reached the end of the sacrifice, / they obtain proper food. / They praise with three [verses]. / Three are these worlds; / from these worlds alone they obtain proper food. / They contain [the word] 'pṛśni'; / food is indeed 'pṛśni'.

2.2.6.s: annamevāvarundhate | manasā prastauti | manasodgāyati | manasā pratiharati | mana iva hi prajāpatiḥ | prajāpaterāptyai | devā vai sarpāḥ | teṣāmiyaṃ rājñī | yathsarparājñiyā ṛgbhiḥ stuvanti | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhanti
2.2.6.d: अन्नमेवावरुन्धते । मनसा प्रस्तौति । मनसोद्गायति । मनसा प्रतिहरति । मन इव हि प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतेराप्त्यै । देवा वै सर्पाः । तेषामियं राज्ञी । यथ्सर्पराज्ञिया ऋग्भिः स्तुवन्ति । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
2.2.6.m: They obtain food itself. / With the mind he chants the prelude; / with the mind he sings the udgītha; / with the mind he chants the response. / For Prajāpati is mind-like; / [it is] for the attainment of Prajāpati. / The gods are the serpents; / of them this [earth] is the queen. / In that they praise with the verses of the Serpent Queen, / they become established on this [earth] itself.

2.2.6.s: caturhotṝn hotā vyācaṣṭe | stutamanuśaṃsati śāntyai | anto vā eṣa yajñasya | yaddaśamamahaḥ | etatkhalu vai devānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ brahma | yaccaturhotāraḥ | daśame'haṃścaturhotṝnvyācaṣṭe | yajñasyaivāntaṃ gatvā | paramaṃ devānāṃ guhyaṃ brahmāvarundhe | tadeva prakāśaṃ gamayati
2.2.6.d: चतुर्होतॄन् होता व्याचष्टे । स्तुतमनुशंसति शान्त्यै । अन्तो वा एष यज्ञस्य । यद्दशममहः । एतत्खलु वै देवानां परमं गुह्यं ब्रह्म । यच्चतुर्होतारः । दशमेऽहंश्चतुर्होतॄन्व्याचष्टे । यज्ञस्यैवान्तं गत्वा । परमं देवानां गुह्यं ब्रह्मावरुन्धे । तदेव प्रकाशं गमयति
2.2.6.m: The Hotṛ recites the Caturhotṛ formulas; / he recites along after the chant for appeasement. / For this is the end of the sacrifice, / namely, the tenth day. / This indeed is the supreme secret brahman of the gods, / namely, the Caturhotṛ formulas. / On the tenth day he recites the Caturhotṛ formulas: / having gone to the very end of the sacrifice, / he secures the supreme secret brahman of the gods. / He brings it to light.

2.2.6.s: tadenaṃ prakāśaṃ gatam | prakāśaṃ prajānāṃ gamayati | vācaṃ yacchati | yajñasya dhṛtyai | yajamānadevatyaṃ vā ahaḥ | bhrātṛvyadevatyā rātriḥ | ahnā rātriṃ dhyāyet | bhrātṛvyasyaiva tallokaṃ vṛṅkte | yaddivā vācaṃ visṛjet | aharbhrātṛvyāyocchiṃṣet | yannaktaṃ visṛjet | rātriṃ bhrātṛvyāyocchiṃṣet | adhivṛkṣasūrye vācaṃ visṛjati | etāvantamevāsmai lokamucchiṃṣati | yāvadādityo'stameti
2.2.6.d: तदेनं प्रकाशं गतम् । प्रकाशं प्रजानां गमयति । वाचं यच्छति । यज्ञस्य धृत्यै । यजमानदेवत्यं वा अहः । भ्रातृव्यदेवत्या रात्रिः । अह्ना रात्रिं ध्यायेत् । भ्रातृव्यस्यैव तल्लोकं वृङ्क्ते । यद्दिवा वाचं विसृजेत् । अहर्भ्रातृव्यायोच्छिंषेत् । यन्नक्तं विसृजेत् । रात्रिं भ्रातृव्यायोच्छिंषेत् । अधिवृक्षसूर्ये वाचं विसृजति । एतावन्तमेवास्मै लोकमुच्छिंषति । यावदादित्योऽस्तमेति
